entry.title: KEPO: Knowledge-Enhanced Preference Optimization for Reinforcement Learning with Reasoning

author.name: Fan Yang, Rui Meng, Trudi Di Qi, Ali Ezzati, Yuxin Wen

entry.summary: KEPO addresses sparse rewards in reasoning RL by combining knowledge-enhanced process supervision with preference optimization. Uses teacher guidance selectively based on trajectory quality.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Memory Compression for Efficient Multi-Agent Debate

entry.title: MindGuard: Guardrail Classifiers for Multi-Turn Mental Health Support

entry.title: Discovering Process-Outcome Credit in Multi-Step LLM Reasoning

entry.title: Hard Constraints Meet Soft Generation: Guaranteed Feasibility for LLM-based Combinatorial Optimization

entry.title: Do All Individual Layers Help? An Empirical Study of Task-Interfering Layers in Vision-Language Models

entry.title: Predictive Scheduling for Efficient Inference-Time Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Katrina Brown, Aneesh Muppidi, Rana Shahout

entry.title: Evolving from Tool User to Creator via Training-Free Experience Reuse in Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Xintian Shen, Jiawei Chen, Lihao Zheng, Hao Ma, Tao Wei, Kun Zhan

author.name: Andong Chen, Wenxin Zhu, Qiuyu Ding, Yuchen Song, Muyun Yang, Tiejun Zhao

author.name: Xun Xu

author.name: Aaron R. Flouro, Shawn P. Chadwick

entry.title: Data Distribution as a Lever for Guiding Optimizers Toward Superior Generalization in LLMs

entry.title: Rethinking LoRA for Data Heterogeneous Federated Learning: Subspace and State Alignment

author.name: Hongyi Peng, Han Yu, Xiaoxiao Li, Qiang Yang

entry.title: SAME: Stabilized Mixture-of-Experts for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning

author.name: Zhen-Hao Xie, Jun-Tao Tang, Yu-Cheng Shi, Han-Jia Ye, De-Chuan Zhan, Da-Wei Zhou

entry.title: Probabilistic Performance Guarantees for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yannik Schnitzer, Mathias Jackermeier, Alessandro Abate, David Parker

entry.title: RE-TRAC: REcursive TRAjectory Compression for Deep Search Agents

author.name: Jialiang Zhu, Gongrui Zhang, Xiaolong Ma, Lin Xu, Miaosen Zhang, Ruiqi Yang, Song Wang, Kai Qiu, Zhirong Wu, Qi Dai, Ruichun Ma, Bei Liu, Yifan Yang, Chong Luo, Zhengyuan Yang, Linjie Li, Lijuan Wang, Weizhu Chen, Xin Geng, Baining Guo

Demonstrates that KA-based layers can entirely replace traditional architectures in medical image segmentation with superior learning capacity.

author.name: Haibo Jin, Kuang Peng, Ye Yu, Xiaopeng Yuan, Haohan Wang

author.name: Haichao Jiang, Tianming Liang, Wei-Shi Zheng, Jian-Fang Hu

author.name: Anusa Saha, Tanmay Joshi, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha, Amitava Das

author.name: Shaoting Zhu, Baijun Ye, Jiaxuan Wang, Jiakang Chen, Ziwen Zhuang, Linzhan Mou, Runhan Huang, Hang Zhao

entry.title: Reward-free Alignment for Conflicting Objectives

author.name: Peter Chen, Xiaopeng Li, Xi Chen, Tianyi Lin

entry.summary: Introduces RACO, a reward-free alignment framework for conflicting objectives that directly uses preference data without reward models while resolving multi-objective trade-offs.

entry.title: SPA-Cache: Singular Proxies for Adaptive Caching in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Wenhao Sun, Rong-Cheng Tu, Yifu Ding, Zhao Jin, Jingyi Liao, Yongcheng Jing, Dacheng Tao

author.name: Linda Ariel Ventura, Victoria Bosch, Tim C Kietzmann, Sushrut Thorat

author.name: Bogdan Zagribelnyy, Ivan Ilin, Maksim Kuznetsov, Nikita Bondarev, Roman Schutski, Thomas MacDougall, Rim Shayakhmetov, Zulfat Miftakhutdinov, Mikolaj Mizera, Vladimir Aladinskiy, Alex Aliper, Alex Zhavoronkov

entry.title: LLM-Inspired Pretrain-Then-Finetune for Small-Data, Large-Scale Optimization

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Language Models to Know What They Know

author.name: Sangjun Park, Elliot Meyerson, Xin Qiu, Risto Miikkulainen

entry.title: MAS-ProVe: Understanding the Process Verification of Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Vishal Venkataramani, Haizhou Shi, Zixuan Ke, Austin Xu, Xiaoxiao He, Yingbo Zhou, Semih Yavuz, Hao Wang, Shafiq Joty

entry.summary: MAS-ProVe systematically studies process verification for multi-agent systems across three paradigms and two granularities, clarifying when and how verification helps MAS.

entry.title: AOrchestra: Automating Sub-Agent Creation for Agentic Orchestration

author.name: Jianhao Ruan, Zhihao Xu, Yiran Peng, Fashen Ren, Zhaoyang Yu, Xinbing Liang, Jinyu Xiang, Bang Liu, Chenglin Wu, Yuyu Luo, Jiayi Zhang

entry.summary: AOrchestra automates sub-agent creation through unified agent abstraction tuple (Instruction, Context, Tools, Model), enabling dynamic orchestration for complex tasks.

entry.title: Beyond Cropping and Rotation: Automated Evolution of Powerful Task-Specific Augmentations with Generative Models

author.name: Judah Goldfeder, Shreyes Kaliyur, Vaibhav Sourirajan, Patrick Minwan Puma, Philippe Martin Wyder, Yuhang Hu, Jiong Lin, Hod Lipson

entry.summary: EvoAug uses evolutionary optimization to automatically design task-specific augmentation pipelines leveraging generative models like diffusion and NeRFs. Addresses the challenge of matching augmentations to tasks.

entry.title: LaVPR: Benchmarking Language and Vision for Place Recognition

author.name: Ofer Idan, Dan Badur, Yosi Keller, Yoli Shavit

entry.summary: LaVPR introduces a large-scale benchmark with 650K language descriptions for visual place recognition, enabling language-based localization for applications like emergency response.

entry.title: Unifying Watermarking via Dimension-Aware Mapping

author.name: Jiale Meng, Runyi Hu, Jie Zhang, Zheming Lu, Ivor Tsang, Tianwei Zhang

entry.summary: DiM unifies watermarking methods as dimension-aware mapping, modeling payloads as 1D messages, 2D masks, or 3D spatiotemporal structures.

entry.title: Contextualized Visual Personalization in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yeongtak Oh, Sangwon Yu, Junsung Park, Han Cheol Moon, Jisoo Mok, Sungroh Yoon

entry.summary: CoViP enables contextualized visual personalization in VLMs through reinforcement learning post-training for image captioning with user-specific visual context.

entry.title: PlanTRansformer: Unified Prediction and Planning with Goal-conditioned Transformer

author.name: Constantin Selzer, Fabina B. Flohr

entry.summary: Introduces PlanTransformer (PTR), unifying trajectory prediction and planning in autonomous driving through goal-conditioned Gaussian Mixture Transformer. Addresses mismatch between multimodal prediction and deterministic planning.

entry.title: Language Movement Primitives: Grounding Language Models in Robot Motion

author.name: Yinlong Dai, Benjamin A. Christie, Daniel J. Evans, Dylan P. Losey, Simon Stepputtis

entry.summary: Proposes Language Movement Primitives for grounding language models in robot motion. Bridges gap between VLM task decomposition and actionable robot motion through motion primitives.

entry.title: CMR: Contractive Mapping Embeddings for Robust Humanoid Locomotion on Unstructured Terrains

author.name: Qixin Zeng, Hongyin Zhang, Shangke Lyu, Junxi Jin, Donglin Wang, Chao Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CMR framework for robust humanoid locomotion using contractive mapping embeddings. Provides theoretical bounds on return gap under observation noise.

entry.title: Aggregation Queries over Unstructured Text: Benchmark and Agentic Method

author.name: Haojia Zhu, Qinyuan Xu, Haoyu Li, Yuxi Liu, Hanchen Qiu, Jiaoyan Chen, Jiahui Jin

entry.summary: Introduces AGGBench for evaluating completeness-oriented aggregation queries over text, where systems must 'find all' rather than 'find one'. Proposes DFA (Disambiguation-Filtering-Aggregation) as a modular baseline.

entry.title: S1-NexusAgent: a Self-Evolving Agent Framework for Multidisciplinary Scientific Research

author.name: NexusAgent Team

entry.summary: S1-NexusAgent is a self-evolving agent framework for scientific research using hierarchical Plan-and-CodeAct execution, supporting thousands of tools via Model Context Protocol for complex research workflows.

entry.title: PRISM: Parametrically Refactoring Inference for Speculative Sampling Draft Models

author.name: Xuliang Wang, Yuetao Chen, Maochan Zhen, Fang Liu, Xinzhou Zheng, Xingwu Liu, Hong Xu, Ming Li

entry.summary: PRISM improves speculative decoding by disaggregating computation across different parameter sets, refactoring the inference process to balance draft quality and compute overhead.

entry.title: Rethinking the Role of Entropy in Optimizing Tool-Use Behaviors for Large Language Model Agents

author.name: Zeping Li, Hongru Wang, Yiwen Zhao, Guanhua Chen, Yixia Li, Keyang Chen, Yixin Cao, Guangnan Ye, Hongfeng Chai, Mengdi Wang, Zhenfei Yin

entry.summary: Finds strong positive correlation between entropy reduction and high-quality tool calls, proposing entropy-based reward strategies for optimizing tool-use behavior in LLM agents.

entry.title: SafeGround: Know When to Trust GUI Grounding Models via Uncertainty Calibration

author.name: Qingni Wang, Yue Fan, Xin Eric Wang

entry.summary: SafeGround provides uncertainty calibration for GUI grounding models, enabling risk-aware predictions through distribution-aware uncertainty quantification and calibrated decision thresholds.

entry.title: AutoBinder Agent: An MCP-Based Agent for End-to-End Protein Binder Design

author.name: Fukang Ge, Jiarui Zhu, Linjie Zhang, Haowen Xiao, Xiangcheng Bao, Fangnan Xie, Danyang Chen, Yanrui Lu, Yuting Wang, Ziqian Guan, Lin Gu, Jinhao Bi, Yingying Zhu

entry.summary: Presents AutoBinder, an MCP-based agent leveraging LLMs to coordinate protein binder design by integrating MaSIF for PPI site identification, Rosetta for grafting, RFdiffusion for backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN for sequence design.

entry.title: Learning Physics-Grounded 4D Dynamics with Neural Gaussian Force Fields

author.name: Shiqian Li, Ruihong Shen, Junfeng Ni, Chang Pan, Chi Zhang, Yixin Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Gaussian Force Field integrating 3D Gaussian perception with physics-based modeling for generating interactive, physically realistic dynamics from visual observations.

entry.title: In-Run Data Shapley for Adam Optimizer

author.name: Meng Ding, Zeqing Zhang, Di Wang, Lijie Hu

entry.summary: Proposes Adam-Aware data attribution method, demonstrating that SGD-based Shapley proxies diverge significantly (R≈0.11) from true contributions under Adam optimization.

entry.title: DISPO: Enhancing Training Efficiency and Stability in Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Batuhan K. Karaman, Aditya Rawal, Suhaila Shakiah, Mohammad Ghavamzadeh, Mingyi Hong, Arijit Biswas, Ruida Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes DISPO for efficient RLVR training, decoupling clipping from gradient computation. Addresses trade-off between PPO stability and REINFORCE efficiency.

entry.title: FreshMem: Brain-Inspired Frequency-Space Hybrid Memory for Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Kangcong Li, Peng Ye, Lin Zhang, Chao Wang, Huafeng Qin, Tao Chen

entry.summary: FreshMem introduces brain-inspired frequency-space hybrid memory for streaming video understanding in MLLMs, combining multi-scale frequency memory for global history with space thumbnail memory for recent events.

entry.title: VLM-Guided Experience Replay

author.name: Elad Sharony, Tom Jurgenson, Orr Krupnik, Dotan Di Castro, Shie Mannor

entry.summary: Uses frozen pre-trained VLMs to guide experience replay prioritization in RL, identifying promising sub-trajectories without fine-tuning.

entry.title: IntraSlice: Towards High-Performance Structural Pruning with Block-Intra PCA for LLMs

author.name: Meng Li, Peisong Wang, Yuantian Shao, Qinghao Hu, Hongjian Fang, Yifan Zhang, Zhihui Wei, Jian Cheng

entry.summary: IntraSlice applies block-wise module-intra PCA compression for LLM structural pruning, avoiding activation distribution disruption from inter-module methods.

entry.title: Backpropagation as Physical Relaxation: Exact Gradients in Finite Time

author.name: Antonino Emanuele Scurria

entry.summary: Shows that backpropagation emerges exactly as the finite-time relaxation of a physical dynamical system, deriving a global energy functional whose saddle-point dynamics perform inference and credit assignment.

entry.title: MemSkill: Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents

author.name: Haozhen Zhang, Quanyu Long, Jianzhu Bao, Tao Feng, Weizhi Zhang, Haodong Yue, Wenya Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MemSkill, reframing memory operations as learnable skills that can evolve, enabling LLM agents to adapt memory strategies to diverse interaction patterns.

entry.title: Enhancing Post-Training Quantization via Future Activation Awareness

author.name: Zheqi Lv, Zhenxuan Fan, Qi Tian, Wenqiao Zhang, Yueting Zhuang

entry.summary: FAQ (Future-Aware Quantization) uses activations from future layers to guide PTQ hyperparameter selection, better preserving important weights and reducing sensitivity to calibration noise.

entry.title: RAP: KV-Cache Compression via RoPE-Aligned Pruning

author.name: Jihao Xin, Tian Lvu, Hatem Ltaief, David Keyes, Marco Canini

entry.summary: RAP addresses incompatibility between RoPE and KV-cache low-rank factorization by pruning entire RoPE-aligned column pairs, enabling true absorption and eliminating reconstruction overhead.

entry.title: Search-Augmented Masked Diffusion Models for Constrained Generation

author.name: Huu Binh Ta (University of Virginia), Michael Cardei (University of Virginia), Alvaro Velasquez (University of Colorado at Boulder), Ferdinando Fioretto (University of Virginia)

entry.summary: SearchDiff integrates informed search into masked diffusion denoising for constrained generation, allowing hard constraint enforcement and non-differentiable property optimization without training.

entry.title: Adaptive Batch Sizes Using Non-Euclidean Gradient Noise Scales for Stochastic Sign and Spectral Descent

author.name: Hiroki Naganuma, Shagun Gupta, Youssef Briki, Ioannis Mitliagkas, Irina Rish, Parameswaran Raman, Hao-Jun Michael Shi

entry.summary: Derives gradient noise scales for signSGD and specSGD from dual norm geometry, proposing efficient estimators for adaptive batch sizing with these optimizers.

entry.title: From Inexact Gradients to Byzantine Robustness: Acceleration and Optimization under Similarity

author.name: Renaud Gaucher, Aymeric Dieuleveut, Hadrien Hendrikx

entry.summary: Shows Byzantine-robust distributed optimization can be cast as optimization with inexact gradient oracles under standard assumptions, enabling development of more complex robust algorithms including accelerated ones.

entry.title: The Label Horizon Paradox: Rethinking Supervision Targets in Financial Forecasting

author.name: Chen-Hui Song, Shuoling Liu, Liyuan Chen

entry.summary: Challenges the assumption that training labels must match inference targets in financial forecasting, uncovering the 'Label Horizon Paradox' where optimal supervision signals deviate from prediction goals.

entry.title: Scaling Continual Learning with Bi-Level Routing Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Meng Lou, Yunxiang Fu, Yizhou Yu

entry.summary: Proposes CaRE with Bi-Level Routing MoE for continual learning, using router selection followed by expert routing to learn discriminative and comprehensive features over long task sequences.

entry.title: WARP Logic Neural Networks

author.name: Lino Gerlach, Thore Gerlach, Liv V{\aa}ge, Elliott Kauffman, Isobel Ojalvo

entry.summary: Introduces WARP logic neural networks for efficient gradient-based learning of hardware-native logic blocks, showing most parameter-efficient representation for Boolean functions.

entry.title: From Task Solving to Robust Real-World Adaptation in LLM Agents

author.name: Pouya Pezeshkpour, Estevam Hruschka

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM agent robustness under realistic deployment conditions: partial observability, unreliable tools, shifting environments, and implicit multi-stakeholder goals.

entry.title: Embodiment-Aware Generalist Specialist Distillation for Unified Humanoid Whole-Body Control

author.name: Quanquan Peng, Yunfeng Lin, Yufei Xue, Jiangmiao Pang, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: EAGLE uses generalist-specialist distillation to train single policy controlling multiple heterogeneous humanoids without per-robot reward tuning.

entry.title: OmniRAG-Agent: Agentic Omnimodal Reasoning for Low-Resource Long Audio-Video Question Answering

author.name: Yifan Zhu, Xinyu Mu, Tao Feng, Zhonghong Ou, Yuning Gong, Haoran Luo

entry.summary: OmniRAG-Agent enables low-resource long audio-video QA through image-audio RAG and agent loops for planning and evidence merging, with GRPO optimization.

entry.title: N\"uwa: Mending the Spatial Integrity Torn by VLM Token Pruning

author.name: Yihong Huang, Fei Ma, Yihua Shao, Jingcai Guo, Zitong Yu, Laizhong Cui, Qi Tian

entry.summary: Nüwa is a token pruning framework for VLMs that maintains spatial integrity through two-stage processing, addressing performance degradation on visual grounding tasks.

entry.title: JRDB-Pose3D: A Multi-person 3D Human Pose and Shape Estimation Dataset for Robotics

author.name: Sandika Biswas, Kian Izadpanah, Hamid Rezatofighi

entry.summary: JRDB-Pose3D provides multi-person 3D pose annotations from a mobile robotic platform in crowded indoor/outdoor environments. Addresses the gap between lab-collected and real-world pose datasets.

entry.title: Z3D: Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding from Images

author.name: Nikita Drozdov, Andrey Lemeshko, Nikita Gavrilov, Anton Konushin, Danila Rukhovich, Maksim Kolodiazhnyi

entry.summary: Z3D enables zero-shot 3D visual grounding from multi-view images without geometric supervision, using advanced instance segmentation and VLM reasoning.

entry.title: Semantic Routing: Exploring Multi-Layer LLM Feature Weighting for Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Bozhou Li, Yushuo Guan, Haolin Li, Bohan Zeng, Yiyan Ji, Yue Ding, Pengfei Wan, Kun Gai, Yuanxing Zhang, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: Explores multi-layer LLM feature weighting for DiT conditioning, finding depth-wise semantic routing as optimal strategy for dynamic text-image alignment.

entry.title: ELIQ: A Label-Free Framework for Quality Assessment of Evolving AI-Generated Images

author.name: Xinyue Li, Zhiming Xu, Zhichao Zhang, Zhaolin Cai, Sijing Wu, Xiongkuo Min, Yitong Chen, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: ELIQ provides label-free quality assessment for AI-generated images by constructing contrastive pairs covering AIGC-specific distortions without human annotations.

entry.title: Automatic Design of Optimization Test Problems with Large Language Models

author.name: Wojciech Achtelik, Hubert Guzowski, Maciej Smo{\l}ka, Jacek Ma\'ndziuk

entry.summary: Introduces EoTF, using LLM-driven evolutionary search to automatically generate optimization test functions matching target ELA feature vectors. Addresses bias in hand-crafted benchmark suites like BBOB.

entry.title: Kino-PAX$^+$: Near-Optimal Massively Parallel Kinodynamic Sampling-based Motion Planner

author.name: Nicolas Perrault, Qi Heng Ho, Morteza Lahijanian

entry.summary: Introduces Kino-PAX+, a massively parallel kinodynamic motion planner with asymptotic near-optimal guarantees. Decomposes serial operations into parallel subroutines for GPU execution.

entry.title: Input-to-State Safe Backstepping: Robust Safety-Critical Control with Unmatched Uncertainties

author.name: Max H. Cohen, Pio Ong, Aaron D. Ames

entry.summary: Presents constructive approach to safety-critical control with unmatched disturbances using Input-to-State Safe CBFs. Outlines procedure for strict-feedback and dual-relative-degree systems.

entry.title: Workflow-R1: Group Sub-sequence Policy Optimization for Multi-turn Workflow Construction

author.name: Mingze Kong, Zikun Qu, Zhongquan Zhou, Pengyu Liang, Xiang Li, Zhiwei Shang, Zhi Hong, Kaiyu Huang, Zhiyong Wang, Zhongxiang Dai

entry.summary: Presents Workflow-R1, which reformulates agentic workflow construction as multi-turn natural language decision-making rather than one-shot code generation. Introduces Group Sub-sequence Policy Optimization (GSsPO) for training.

entry.title: Entropy-Guided Data-Efficient Training for Multimodal Reasoning Reward Models

author.name: Shidong Yang, Tongwen Huang, Hao Wen, Yong Wang, Li Chen, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Identifies strong correlation between response entropy and accuracy in multimodal reward models, proposing Entropy-Guided Training to filter noisy samples and handle difficulty variations.

entry.title: TIDE: Trajectory-based Diagnostic Evaluation of Test-Time Improvement in LLM Agents

author.name: Hang Yan, Xinyu Che, Fangzhi Xu, Qiushi Sun, Zichen Ding, Kanzhi Cheng, Jian Zhang, Tao Qin, Jun Liu, Qika Lin

entry.summary: TIDE provides diagnostic evaluation framework for test-time improvement in agents, measuring temporal dynamics, behavior adaptation after errors, and working memory utility.

entry.title: Happy Young Women, Grumpy Old Men? Emotion-Driven Demographic Biases in Synthetic Face Generation

author.name: Mengting Wei, Aditya Gulati, Guoying Zhao, Nuria Oliver

entry.title: SPARC-RAG: Adaptive Sequential-Parallel Scaling with Context Management for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Yuxin Yang, Gangda Deng, \"Omer Faruk Akg\"ul, Nima Chitsazan, Yash Govilkar, Akasha Tigalappanavara, Shi-Xiong Zhang, Sambit Sahu, Viktor Prasanna

entry.title: Block removal for large language models through constrained binary optimization

author.name: David Jansen, Roman Rausch, David Montero, Roman Orus

entry.summary: Formulates LLM block removal as a constrained binary optimization problem mappable to an Ising model, enabling efficient ranking of block-removal configurations. Outperforms state-of-the-art block pruning methods.

entry.title: DIVERGE: Diversity-Enhanced RAG for Open-Ended Information Seeking

author.name: Tianyi Hu, Niket Tandon, Akhil Arora

entry.summary: DIVERGE addresses RAG systems' failure to produce diverse outputs for open-ended queries by introducing reflection-guided generation and memory-augmented retrieval as a plug-and-play framework.

entry.title: TimeBlind: A Spatio-Temporal Compositionality Benchmark for Video LLMs

author.name: Baiqi Li, Kangyi Zhao, Ce Zhang, Chancharik Mitra, Jean de Dieu Nyandwi, Gedas Bertasius

entry.summary: TimeBlind benchmark for video LLM spatio-temporal understanding using minimal-pairs paradigm where video pairs share static content but differ only in temporal structure.

entry.title: LatentLens: Revealing Highly Interpretable Visual Tokens in LLMs

author.name: Benno Krojer, Shravan Nayak, Oscar Ma\~nas, Vaibhav Adlakha, Desmond Elliott, Siva Reddy, Marius Mosbach

entry.title: Convergent World Representations and Divergent Tasks

author.name: Core Francisco Park

entry.summary: Studies how neural networks develop world representations through controlled experiments with city coordinates and geometric tasks. Finds multi-task training drives convergence of world representations even across non-overlapping tasks.

entry.title: Deep Time-series Forecasting Needs Kernelized Moment Balancing

author.name: Licheng Pan, Hao Wang, Haocheng Yang, Yuqi Li, Qingsong Wen, Xiaoxi Li, Zhichao Chen, Haoxuan Li, Zhixuan Chu, Yuan Lu

entry.summary: Proves existing time series forecasting objectives fail to achieve true distribution balance and proposes KMB-DF using kernelized moment balancing in RKHS. Provides theoretical foundation for forecasting objective design.

entry.title: Autoregressive, Yet Revisable: In Decoding Revision for Secure Code Generation

author.name: Chengran Yang, Zichao Wei, Heminghao Deng, Jinfeng Jiang, Zhensu Sun, Ting Zhang, Tianyi Wu, Ming Wen, David Lo

entry.summary: Proposes Stream of Revision for secure code generation, introducing action tokens that enable LLMs to revise previously generated code during decoding rather than monotonic token generation.

entry.title: PACER: Blockwise Pre-verification for Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Length

author.name: Situo Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Zichen Zhu, Hankun Wang, Da Ma, Danyang Zhang, Lu Chen, Kai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes PACER for speculative decoding that dynamically controls draft length using a trainable pre-verification layer, adapting to varying optimal draft lengths across decoding steps.

entry.title: InfoTok: Regulating Information Flow for Capacity-Constrained Shared Visual Tokenization in Unified MLLMs

author.name: Lv Tang, Tianyi Zheng, Bo Li, Xingyu Li

entry.summary: Introduces capacity-constrained perspective for visual tokenization in unified MLLMs. Proposes InfoTok that prioritizes reusable structure over high-entropy variations through information-theoretic lens.

author.name: Zeqiao Li, Yijing Wang, Haoyu Wang, Zheng Li, Zhiqiang Zuo

entry.summary: FLAME integrates flow matching with maximum entropy RL, enabling one-step generation while maintaining exploration-exploitation balance. Introduces Q-reweighted flow matching and decoupled entropy estimator to handle intractable energy-based distributions.

entry.title: : One LLM Token for Explicit Graph Structural Understanding

author.name: Jingyao Wu, Bin Lu, Zijun Di, Xiaoying Gan, Meng Jin, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang, Chenghu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes special token to represent graph structure within unified token space via topology-aware structural tokenizer, addressing structural hallucination in LLMs processing graphs.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Off-Policy Learning

author.name: Arip Asadulaev, Maksim Bobrin, Salem Lahlou, Dmitry Dylov, Fakhri Karray, Martin Takac

entry.summary: Discovers theoretical connection between successor measures and stationary density ratios for zero-shot off-policy learning, enabling optimal importance sampling without additional training.

entry.title: Vision-DeepResearch Benchmark: Rethinking Visual and Textual Search for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yu Zeng, Wenxuan Huang, Zhen Fang, Shuang Chen, Yufan Shen, Yishuo Cai, Xiaoman Wang, Zhenfei Yin, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Shiting Huang, Yiming Zhao, Yao Hu, Philip Torr, Wanli Ouyang, Shaosheng Cao

entry.summary: Introduces Vision-DeepResearch Benchmark for evaluating visual and textual search capabilities in MLLMs, addressing limitations where answers can be leaked through text or prior knowledge.

entry.title: Didactic to Constructive: Turning Expert Solutions into Learnable Reasoning

author.name: Ethan Mendes, Jungsoo Park, Alan Ritter

entry.summary: Proposes converting expert didactic solutions into constructive learnable reasoning, addressing the out-of-distribution problem when training on high-quality human solutions.

entry.title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention implements projection of inputs onto a common surface

author.name: Terence D Sanger

entry.summary: Provides alternative mathematical interpretation of scaled dot-product attention as projection onto input-determined surfaces, rather than query-key-value database operations. Shows SDPA discovers time/context-dependent nonlinear dependencies.

entry.title: Trajectory Consistency for One-Step Generation on Euler Mean Flows

author.name: Zhiqi Li, Yuchen Sun, Duowen Chen, Jinjin He, Bo Zhu

entry.summary: Euler Mean Flows enforce long-range trajectory consistency for one/few-step diffusion generation via linear surrogate objective, enabling direct data supervision without JVP computation.

entry.title: Privately Fine-Tuned LLMs Preserve Temporal Dynamics in Tabular Data

author.name: Lucas Rosenblatt, Peihan Liu, Ryan McKenna, Natalia Ponomareva

entry.summary: PATH framework for differentially private synthetic tabular data that preserves temporal coherence in longitudinal data, treating full user histories as generation targets rather than flattening.

entry.title: Structure-Preserving Learning Improves Geometry Generalization in Neural PDEs

author.name: Benjamin D. Shaffer, Shawn Koohy, Brooks Kinch, M. Ani Hsieh, Nathaniel Trask

entry.summary: Introduces Geo-NeW, a data-driven finite element method that jointly learns differential operators and compatible finite element spaces while exactly preserving physical conservation laws. Achieves geometry generalization through structure-preserving learning.

entry.title: Self-Soupervision: Cooking Model Soups without Labels

author.name: Anthony Fuller, James R. Green, Evan Shelhamer

entry.summary: Generalizes model soups to self-supervised learning, enabling parameter mixing without labels. Shows Self-Souping on corrupted data improves robustness by +3.5% on ImageNet-C and +7% on LAION-C.

entry.title: Contrastive Concept-Tree Search for LLM-Assisted Algorithm Discovery

author.name: Timothee Leleu, Sudeera Gunathilaka, Federico Ghimenti, Surya Ganguli

entry.summary: Proposes Contrastive Concept-Tree Search for LLM-assisted algorithm discovery, extracting hierarchical concept representation from programs and learning contrastive model for parent selection.

entry.title: Topology Matters: A Cautionary Case Study of Graph SSL on Neuro-Inspired Benchmarks

author.name: May Kristine Jonson Carlon, Su Myat Noe, Haojiong Wang, Yasuo Kuniyoshi

entry.summary: Reveals that invariance-based self-supervised learning fundamentally fails on brain-connectome-like topological benchmarks, being outperformed by classical topology-aware heuristics. Identifies objective mismatch between SSL and topological properties.

entry.title: A Function-Space Stability Boundary for Generalization in Interpolating Learning Systems

author.name: Ronald Katende

entry.summary: Proposes function-space stability framework for understanding generalization in interpolating systems, introducing contractive propagation condition and stability certificate that predicts generalization.

entry.title: Quantization-Aware Regularizers for Deep Neural Networks Compression

author.name: Dario Malchiodi, Mattia Ferraretto, Marco Frasca

entry.summary: Introduces quantization-aware regularizers that drive weights to form clusters during training, integrating quantization awareness into the learning phase rather than post-hoc application.

entry.title: Efficient Estimation of Kernel Surrogate Models for Task Attribution

author.name: Zhenshuo Zhang, Minxuan Duan, Hongyang R. Zhang

entry.summary: Develops kernel surrogate models to quantify how individual training tasks influence LLM performance on target tasks, capturing nonlinear interactions like synergy beyond prior linear approaches.

entry.title: WorldVQA: Measuring Atomic World Knowledge in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Runjie Zhou, Youbo Shao, Haoyu Lu, Bowei Xing, Tongtong Bai, Yujie Chen, Jie Zhao, Lin Sui, Haotian Yao, Zijia Zhao, Hao Yang, Haoning Wu, Zaida Zhou, Jinguo Zhu, Zhiqi Huang, Yiping Bao, Yangyang Liu, Y. Charles, Xinyu Zhou

entry.summary: WorldVQA benchmark evaluates MLLMs on atomic visual world knowledge, decoupling visual retrieval from reasoning to measure factual visual memory across head-to-tail entities.

entry.title: Training-Free Self-Correction for Multimodal Masked Diffusion Models

author.name: Yidong Ouyang, Panwen Hu, Zhengyan Wan, Zhe Wang, Liyan Xie, Dmitriy Bespalov, Ying Nian Wu, Guang Cheng, Hongyuan Zha, Qiang Sun

entry.summary: Proposes training-free self-correction for masked diffusion models that exploits pretrained model inductive biases without modifying parameters or auxiliary evaluators.

entry.title: GFlowPO: Generative Flow Network as a Language Model Prompt Optimizer

author.name: Junmo Cho, Suhan Kim, Sangjune An, Minsu Kim, Dong Bok Lee, Heejun Lee, Sung Ju Hwang, Hae Beom Lee

entry.summary: Proposes GFlowPO, using Generative Flow Networks for LLM prompt optimization by casting prompt search as posterior inference over latent prompts. Uses off-policy training with replay to improve sample efficiency over existing on-policy RL methods.

entry.title: DiscoverLLM: From Executing Intents to Discovering Them

author.name: Tae Soo Kim, Yoonjoo Lee, Jaesang Yu, John Joon Young Chung, Juho Kim

entry.summary: Introduces DiscoverLLM, a framework training LLMs to help users discover and form intents they haven't yet expressed, using a novel user simulator modeling cognitive state with a hierarchy of progressively concretizing intents.

entry.title: DALI: A Workload-Aware Offloading Framework for Efficient MoE Inference on Local PCs

author.name: Zeyu Zhu, Gang Li, Peisong Wang, Zitao Mo, Minnan Pei, Zhuoran Song, Xiaoyao Liang, Jian Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes DALI, a workload-aware MoE offloading framework addressing CPU-GPU load imbalance and inaccurate prefetching in existing approaches by dynamically matching expert workloads.

entry.title: STEMVerse: A Dual-Axis Diagnostic Framework for STEM Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Xuzhao Li, Xuchen Li, Jian Zhao, Shiyu Hu

entry.summary: Proposes STEMVerse, a diagnostic framework for STEM reasoning in LLMs that goes beyond aggregate scores to distinguish whether errors stem from insufficient domain knowledge or cognitive capacity deficiencies.

entry.title: Equal Access, Unequal Interaction: A Counterfactual Audit of LLM Fairness

author.name: Alireza Amiri-Margavi, Arshia Gharagozlou, Amin Gholami Davodi, Seyed Pouyan Mousavi Davoudi, Hamidreza Hasani Balyani

entry.summary: Conducts fairness audit showing equitable LLM access doesn't ensure equitable interaction quality, finding differences in tone, uncertainty, and linguistic framing across demographic identities after access is granted.

entry.title: SAES-SVD: Self-Adaptive Suppression of Accumulated and Local Errors for SVD-based LLM Compression

author.name: Xing Hu, Dawei Yang, Yuan Cheng, Zhixuan Chen, Zukang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes SAES-SVD for LLM compression that jointly optimizes intra-layer reconstruction and inter-layer error compensation, addressing the accumulation of reconstruction error through the network.

entry.title: ATACompressor: Adaptive Task-Aware Compression for Efficient Long-Context Processing in LLMs

author.name: Xuancheng Li, Haitao Li, Yujia Zhou, Qingyao Ai, Yiqun Liu

entry.summary: ATACompressor dynamically adjusts compression based on task requirements, using a selective encoder that compresses only task-relevant portions to address the 'lost in the middle' problem.

entry.title: Aligning Language Model Benchmarks with Pairwise Preferences

author.name: Marco Gutierrez, Xinyi Leng, Hannah Cyberey, Jonathan Richard Schwarz, Ahmed Alaa, Thomas Hartvigsen

entry.summary: BenchAlign learns preference-aligned weightings for benchmark questions using model pairwise preferences to produce benchmarks that better predict real-world utility.

entry.summary: Presents EventNeuS, a self-supervised neural model for 3D mesh reconstruction from monocular event camera streams. First to combine SDF and density field learning with event-based supervision.

entry.title: HetroD: A High-Fidelity Drone Dataset and Benchmark for Autonomous Driving in Heterogeneous Traffic

author.name: Yu-Hsiang Chen, Wei-Jer Chang, Christian Kotulla, Thomas Keutgens, Steffen Runde, Tobias Moers, Christoph Klas, Wei Zhan, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Yi-Ting Chen

entry.summary: Introduces HetroD, a drone-based dataset for autonomous driving in heterogeneous traffic with vulnerable road users. Captures complex behaviors like hook turns and lane splitting underrepresented in existing datasets.

entry.title: PokeNet: Learning Kinematic Models of Articulated Objects from Human Observations

author.name: Anmol Gupta, Weiwei Gu, Omkar Patil, Jun Ki Lee, Nakul Gopalan

entry.summary: Presents PokeNet for learning kinematic models of articulated objects from human observation videos. Estimates joint parameters including order of manipulations without prior knowledge about joint types.

entry.title: Learning-based Adaptive Control of Quadruped Robots for Active Stabilization on Moving Platforms

author.name: Minsung Yoon, Heechan Shin, Jeil Jeong, Sung-Eui Yoon

entry.summary: Presents LAS-MP for quadruped robot stabilization on moving platforms using learning-based adaptive control. Introduces platform trajectory generation and scheduling methods.

entry.title: Formal Evidence Generation for Assurance Cases for Robotic Software Models

author.name: Fang Yan, Simon Foster, Ana Cavalcanti, Ibrahim Habli, James Baxter

entry.summary: Presents model-based approach for systematically generating formal verification evidence for robotics assurance cases. Derives assertions from requirements using templates and orchestrates multiple verification tools.

entry.title: Conditionalization Confounds Inoculation Prompting Results

author.name: Maxime Riché

entry.summary: Demonstrates that inoculation prompting results are confounded by conditionalization - learned traits only express conditional on specific context features. Shows rephrasing prompts reduces but doesn't fully solve the problem.

entry.title: PRISM: Festina Lente Proactivity -- Risk-Sensitive, Uncertainty-Aware Deliberation for Proactive Agents

author.name: Yuxuan Fu, Xiaoyu Tan, Teqi Hao, Chen Zhan, Xihe Qiu

entry.summary: PRISM formulates proactive agent intervention as cost-sensitive selective intervention, using calibrated acceptance probability thresholds and dual-process (fast/slow) reasoning architecture.

entry.title: Constrained Process Maps for Multi-Agent Generative AI Workflows

author.name: Ananya Joshi, Michael Rudow

entry.summary: Formalizes multi-agent LLM workflows as finite-horizon MDPs with DAG structure, where agents handle specific roles with predefined transitions and epistemic uncertainty representation.

entry.title: PTCBENCH: Benchmarking Contextual Stability of Personality Traits in LLM Systems

author.name: Jiongchi Yu, Yuhan Ma, Xiaoyu Zhang, Junjie Wang, Qiang Hu, Chao Shen, Xiaofei Xie

entry.summary: Introduces PTCBENCH benchmark to assess LLM personality consistency under 12 situational contexts using NEO Five-Factor Inventory, analyzing 39,240 personality trait records to reveal context-dependent personality variations.

entry.title: R3G: A Reasoning--Retrieval--Reranking Framework for Vision-Centric Answer Generation

author.name: Zhuohong Chen, Zhengxian Wu, Zirui Liao, Shenao Jiang, Hangrui Xu, Yang Chen, Chaokui Su, Xiaoyu Liu, Haoqian Wang

entry.summary: Proposes R3G framework for vision-centric QA with reasoning plan generation, two-stage retrieval-reranking, and sufficiency-aware evidence selection, achieving SOTA on MRAG-Bench.

entry.title: Stein-Rule Shrinkage for Stochastic Gradient Estimation in High Dimensions

author.name: M. Arashi, M. Amintoosi

entry.summary: Applies Stein-rule shrinkage to stochastic gradient estimation in high dimensions, providing decision-theoretic framework showing unbiased gradients are inadmissible under quadratic loss.

entry.title: FlyPrompt: Brain-Inspired Random-Expanded Routing with Temporal-Ensemble Experts for General Continual Learning

author.name: Hongwei Yan, Guanglong Sun, Kanglei Zhou, Qian Li, Liyuan Wang, Yi Zhong

entry.summary: FlyPrompt draws from fruit fly memory system for general continual learning with sparse expansion and modular ensembles, addressing expert allocation in continual parameter-efficient tuning.

entry.title: Decoupling Generalizability and Membership Privacy Risks in Neural Networks

author.name: Xingli Fang, Jung-Eun Kim

entry.summary: Identifies that model generalization and privacy risks exist in different regions of neural network architectures, proposing PPTP to protect vulnerable components while maintaining utility.

entry.title: Active Causal Experimentalist (ACE): Learning Intervention Strategies via Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Patrick Cooper, Alvaro Velasquez

entry.summary: Introduces ACE (Active Causal Experimentalist), learning experimental design as a sequential policy using Direct Preference Optimization for causal discovery.

entry.title: BatCoder: Self-Supervised Bidirectional Code-Documentation Learning via Back-Translation

author.name: Jingwen Xu, Yiyang Lu, Zisu Huang, Changze Lv, Xiaohua Wang, Shizheng Li, Zhibo Xu, Zhengkang Guo, Zhengyuan Wang, Muzhao Tian, Xuanjing Huang, Xiaoqing Zheng

entry.title: MARA: Continuous SE(3)-Equivariant Attention for Molecular Force Fields

author.name: Francesco Leonardi, Boris Bonev, Kaspar Riesen

entry.summary: MARA extends spherical attention to SE(3)-equivariant molecular force fields, operating directly on angular-radial coordinates for flexible geometric weighting without fixed angular expansions.

entry.title: Exposing Vulnerabilities in Explanation for Time Series Classifiers via Dual-Target Attacks

author.name: Bohan Wang, Zewen Liu, Lu Lin, Hui Liu, Li Xiong, Ming Jin, Wei Jin

entry.summary: TSEF dual-target attack on time series classifiers that simultaneously achieves targeted misclassification while keeping explanations consistent with chosen reference, exposing XAI vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Clarify Before You Draw: Proactive Agents for Robust Text-to-CAD Generation

author.name: Bo Yuan, Zelin Zhao, Petr Molodyk, Bin Hu, Yongxin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes ProCAD, a proactive agentic framework for text-to-CAD that asks clarification questions before code synthesis when specifications are under-specified or inconsistent.

entry.title: FlashSinkhorn: IO-Aware Entropic Optimal Transport

author.name: Felix X. -F. Ye, Xingjie Li, An Yu, Ming-Ching Chang, Linsong Chu, Davis Wertheimer

entry.summary: Presents FlashSinkhorn, an IO-aware entropic optimal transport solver achieving FlashAttention-style fusion for Sinkhorn iterations, enabling 10x faster computation at scale.

entry.title: Lipschitz Multiscale Deep Equilibrium Models: A Theoretically Guaranteed and Accelerated Approach

author.name: Naoki Sato, Hideaki Iiduka

entry.summary: Develops Lipschitz Multiscale Deep Equilibrium Models with convergence guarantees and accelerated fixed-point iterations, addressing the computational efficiency limitations of standard DEQs.

entry.title: Aligning Forest and Trees in Images and Long Captions for Visually Grounded Understanding

author.name: Byeongju Woo, Zilin Wang, Byeonghyun Pak, Sangwoo Mo, Stella X. Yu

entry.summary: CAFT enables hierarchical image-text learning for long captions through coupled fine-to-coarse visual and text hierarchies aligned without pixel-level supervision.

entry.title: SRA-Seg: Synthetic to Real Alignment for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: OFM Riaz Rahman Aranya, Kevin Desai

entry.summary: SRA-Seg aligns synthetic and real medical image distributions using DINOv2 embeddings and soft edge blending, enabling semi-supervised segmentation from synthetic data.

entry.title: A Unified Candidate Set with Scene-Adaptive Refinement via Diffusion for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhengfei Wu, Shuaixi Pan, Shuohan Chen, Shuo Yang, Yanjun Huang

entry.title: Variance-Reduced Model Predictive Path Integral via Quadratic Model Approximation

author.name: Fabian Schramm, Franki Nguimatsia Tiofack, Nicolas Perrin-Gilbert, Marc Toussaint, Justin Carpentier

entry.title: Addressing Explainability of Generative AI using SMILE (Statistical Model-agnostic Interpretability with Local Explanations)

author.name: Zeinab Dehghani

entry.title: RE-MCDF: Closed-Loop Multi-Expert LLM Reasoning for Knowledge-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis

author.name: Shaowei Shen, Xiaohong Yang, Jie Yang, Lianfen Huang, Yongcai Zhang, Yang Zou, Seyyedali Hosseinalipour

entry.summary: Proposes RE-MCDF for clinical diagnosis using multi-expert LLM reasoning with closed-loop validation. Addresses challenges of heterogeneous, sparse, and noisy electronic medical records in neurology.

entry.title: Efficient Cross-Architecture Knowledge Transfer for Large-Scale Online User Response Prediction

author.name: Yucheng Wu, Yuekui Yang, Hongzheng Li, Anan Liu, Jian Xiao, Junjie Zhai, Huan Yu, Shaoping Ma, Leye Wang

entry.title: Context Learning for Multi-Agent Discussion

author.name: Xingyuan Hua, Sheng Yue, Xinyi Li, Yizhe Zhao, Jinrui Zhang, Ju Ren

entry.title: Unlocking Electronic Health Records: A Hybrid Graph RAG Approach to Safe Clinical AI for Patient QA

author.name: Samuel Thio, Matthew Lewis, Spiros Denaxas, Richard JB Dobson

entry.title: ECCO: Evidence-Driven Causal Reasoning for Compiler Optimization

author.name: Haolin Pan, Lianghong Huang, Jinyuan Dong, Mingjie Xing, Yanjun Wu

entry.title: RAPTOR: Ridge-Adaptive Logistic Probes

entry.title: Why Are AI Agent Involved Pull Requests (Fix-Related) Remain Unmerged? An Empirical Study

author.name: Khairul Alam, Saikat Mondal, Banani Roy

entry.title: QUASAR: A Universal Autonomous System for Atomistic Simulation and a Benchmark of Its Capabilities

author.name: Fengxu Yang, Jack D. Evans

entry.title: LogicGaze: Benchmarking Causal Consistency in Visual Narratives via Counterfactual Verification

author.name: Rory Driscoll, Alexandros Christoforos, Chadbourne Davis

entry.title: Rethinking Zero-Shot Time Series Classification: From Task-specific Classifiers to In-Context Inference

author.name: Juntao Fang, Shifeng Xie, Shengbin Nie, Yuhui Ling, Yuming Liu, Zijian Li, Keli Zhang, Lujia Pan, Themis Palpanas, Ruichu Cai

entry.title: SA-VLA: Spatially-Aware Flow-Matching for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xu Pan, Zhenglin Wan, Xingrui Yu, Xianwei Zheng, Youkai Ke, Ming Sun, Rui Wang, Ziwei Wang, Ivor Tsang

entry.title: EffGen: Enabling Small Language Models as Capable Autonomous Agents

author.name: Gaurav Srivastava, Aafiya Hussain, Chi Wang, Yingyan Celine Lin, Xuan Wang

entry.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Brain-to-Speech Models Across Speech Modes

author.name: Maryam Maghsoudi, Ayushi Mishra

entry.summary: Applies mechanistic interpretability techniques including cross-mode activation patching and causal tracing to brain-to-speech neural decoders across vocalized, mimed, and imagined speech modes.

entry.title: Multi-LLM Adaptive Conformal Inference for Reliable LLM Responses

entry.title: Plain Transformers are Surprisingly Powerful Link Predictors

author.name: Quang Truong, Yu Song, Donald Loveland, Mingxuan Ju, Tong Zhao, Neil Shah, Jiliang Tang

entry.title: Toward Enhancing Representation Learning in Federated Multi-Task Settings

entry.title: Counting Hypothesis: Potential Mechanism of In-Context Learning

author.name: Jung H. Lee, Sujith Vijayan

author.name: Tiantian Chen, Jiaqi Lu, Ying Shen, Lin Zhang

entry.title: Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Agent Communication through Information Bottleneck and Vector Quantization

author.name: Ahmad Farooq, Kamran Iqbal

entry.title: FiLoRA: Focus-and-Ignore LoRA for Controllable Feature Reliance

author.name: Hyunsuk Chung, Caren Han, Yerin Choi, Seungyeon Ji, Jinwoo Kim, Eun-Jung Holden, Kyungreem Han

entry.title: OpenSeal: Good, Fast, and Cheap Construction of an Open-Source Southeast Asian LLM via Parallel Data

author.name: Tan Sang Nguyen, Muhammad Reza Qorib, Hwee Tou Ng

entry.title: BayeSQP: Bayesian Optimization through Sequential Quadratic Programming

entry.title: ScDiVa: Masked Discrete Diffusion for Joint Modeling of Single-Cell Identity and Expression

entry.summary: Analyzes MAE representations, showing they're robust to degradations like blur and occlusions, with embeddings becoming increasingly class-separable across network depth.

entry.title: Optimization and Generation in Aerodynamics Inverse Design

entry.title: Fast-MWEM: Private Data Release in Sublinear Time

author.name: Themistoklis Haris, Steve Choi, Mutiraj Laksanawisit

author.name: Yesom Park, Annie C. Lu, Shao-Ching Huang, Qiyang Hu, Y. Sungtaek Ju, Stanley Osher

author.name: Romain Cosentino

entry.title: Beyond Content: Behavioral Policies Reveal Actors in Information Operations

author.name: Philipp J. Schneider, Lanqin Yuan, Marian-Andrei Rizoiu

entry.summary: Identifies malicious actors in information operations from behavioral policies modeled as sequential decision processes, analyzing Reddit IRA accounts.

entry.title: A Multi-scale Linear-time Encoder for Whole-Slide Image Analysis

author.name: Jagan Mohan Reddy Dwarampudi, Joshua Wong, Hien Van Nguyen, Tania Banerjee

entry.title: Building Interpretable Models for Moral Decision-Making

entry.title: CoCoEmo: Composable and Controllable Human-Like Emotional TTS via Activation Steering

entry.title: Preference-based Conditional Treatment Effects and Policy Learning

entry.title: MIRROR: A Multi-Agent Framework with Iterative Adaptive Revision and Hierarchical Retrieval for Optimization Modeling in Operations Research

author.name: Yifan Shi, Jialong Shi, Jiayi Wang, Ye Fan, Jianyong Sun

entry.title: Controlling Output Rankings in Generative Engines for LLM-based Search

author.name: Haibo Jin, Ruoxi Chen, Peiyan Zhang, Yifeng Luo, Huimin Zeng, Man Luo, Haohan Wang

entry.title: Decoupling Skeleton and Flesh: Efficient Multimodal Table Reasoning with Disentangled Alignment and Structure-aware Guidance

author.name: Yingjie Zhu, Xuefeng Bai, Kehai Chen, Yang Xiang, Youcheng Pan, Xiaoqiang Zhou, Min Zhang

entry.summary: DiSCo and Table-GLS adapt LVLMs to table reasoning through disentangled structure-content alignment and structure-aware guidance without expensive training or external tools.

entry.title: Video-OPD: Efficient Post-Training of Multimodal Large Language Models for Temporal Video Grounding via On-Policy Distillation

entry.title: Flexible Geometric Guidance for Probabilistic Human Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models

entry.title: ConsisDrive: Identity-Preserving Driving World Models for Video Generation by Instance Mask

author.name: Zhuoran Yang, Yanyong Zhang

entry.title: LEVIO: Lightweight Embedded Visual Inertial Odometry for Resource-Constrained Devices

author.name: Jonas K\"uhne, Christian Vogt, Michele Magno, Luca Benini

entry.summary: LEVIO presents a lightweight visual-inertial odometry pipeline optimized for ultra-low-power embedded platforms, enabling real-time 6-DoF sensing.

entry.title: Hierarchical Concept-to-Appearance Guidance for Multi-Subject Image Generation

entry.title: SANEval: Open-Vocabulary Compositional Benchmarks with Failure-mode Diagnosis

author.name: Ariel Shaulov, Eitan Shaar, Amit Edenzon, Lior Wolf

entry.title: VoxServe: Streaming-Centric Serving System for Speech Language Models

entry.title: AdaFuse: Adaptive Multimodal Fusion for Lung Cancer Risk Prediction via Reinforcement Learning

entry.title: LLMs as High-Dimensional Nonlinear Autoregressive Models with Attention: Training, Alignment and Inference

author.name: Vikram Krishnamurthy

entry.title: From Junior to Senior: Allocating Agency and Navigating Professional Growth in Agentic AI-Mediated Software Engineering

entry.title: RMFlow: Refined Mean Flow by a Noise-Injection Step for Multimodal Generation

entry.title: Research Summary: February 03, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research features potentially transformative efficiency advances and critical safety findings. A symmetry-aware Taylor approximation claims to achieve constant-cost self-attention per token—if validated, a fundamental breakthrough. Meta introduces Fault Tolerant HSDP enabling training on 100K+ GPUs with graceful failure recovery.

  • Kimi K2.5 releases as open-source multimodal agent with novel Agent Swarm parallel orchestration architecture
  • Tele-Lens probing reveals myopic planning in Chain-of-Thought without global task awareness—challenging CoT assumptions
  • BLOCK-EM achieves 95% reduction in emergent misalignment by constraining causal features during fine-tuning
  • ReasoningBomb exposes DoS vulnerabilities in reasoning models by inducing pathologically long traces

Theoretical advances include polylog(1/δ) sampling complexity for diffusion models (exponential improvement), formal proofs that transformers learn factored representations in orthogonal subspaces, and a relative-budget theory explaining when RLVR succeeds. Grad2Reward extracts dense process rewards directly from LLM judge gradients, addressing reward sparsity in long-form reasoning.

author.name: Xiaogeng Liu, Xinyan Wang, Yechao Zhang, Sanjay Kariyappa, Chong Xiang, Muhao Chen, G. Edward Suh, Chaowei Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces ReasoningBomb, a new class of denial-of-service attacks targeting large reasoning models by inducing pathologically long reasoning traces. Formalizes PI-DoS attacks with three key properties: amplification, stealthiness, and optimizability.

entry.title: No Global Plan in Chain-of-Thought: Uncover the Latent Planning Horizon of LLMs

author.name: Liyan Xu, Mo Yu, Fandong Meng, Jie Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Tele-Lens probing method revealing LLMs exhibit myopic planning horizon in Chain-of-Thought, conducting incremental transitions without precise global planning.

entry.title: AICD Bench: A Challenging Benchmark for AI-Generated Code Detection

author.name: Daniil Orel, Dilshod Azizov, Indraneil Paul, Yuxia Wang, Iryna Gurevych, Preslav Nakov

entry.summary: Introduces AICD Bench, comprehensive benchmark for AI-generated code detection with 2M examples, 77 models across 11 families, 9 languages, including reasoning models and three realistic detection tasks.

entry.title: BLOCK-EM: Preventing Emergent Misalignment by Blocking Causal Features

author.name: Muhammed Ustaomeroglu, Guannan Qu

entry.summary: Proposes BLOCK-EM for preventing emergent misalignment by identifying and constraining internal features that control misaligned behavior during fine-tuning. Achieves up to 95% reduction in emergent misalignment across six domains.

entry.title: Grad2Reward: From Sparse Judgment to Dense Rewards for Improving Open-Ended LLM Reasoning

author.name: Zheng Zhang, Ao Lu, Yuanhao Zeng, Ziwei Shan, Jinjin Guo, Lufei Li, Yexin Li, Kan Ren

entry.summary: Introduces Grad2Reward framework that extracts dense process rewards directly from LLM judge gradients, converting sparse sequence-level rewards into fine-grained supervision for RLHF on open-ended tasks.

entry.title: MAGIC: A Co-Evolving Attacker-Defender Adversarial Game for Robust LLM Safety

author.name: Xiaoyu Wen, Zhida He, Han Qi, Ziyu Wan, Zhongtian Ma, Ying Wen, Tianhang Zheng, Xingcheng Xu, Chaochao Lu, Qiaosheng Zhang

entry.summary: MAGIC frames LLM safety alignment as adversarial game where attacker agent discovers vulnerabilities while defender agent learns to refuse, enabling co-evolution that uncovers long-tail vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Breaking the Reversal Curse in Autoregressive Language Models via Identity Bridge

author.name: Xutao Ma, Yixiao Huang, Hanlin Zhu, Somayeh Sojoudi

entry.summary: Proposes 'Identity Bridge' to address the reversal curse in autoregressive LLMs, where models trained on 'A→B' cannot deduce 'B→A'. Claims to mitigate what was previously considered a fundamental limitation of causal LLMs.

entry.title: Learning Robust Reasoning through Guided Adversarial Self-Play

author.name: Shuozhe Li, Vaishnav Tadiparthi, Kwonjoon Lee, Nakul Agarwal, Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub, Ehsan Moradi Pari, Lizhang Chen, Amy Zhang, Liu Leqi

entry.summary: GASP introduces adversarial self-play within a single model to train detect-and-repair capabilities for reasoning, using only outcome verification. A polluter induces coherent corruptions while an agent learns to recover.

entry.title: Jailbreaking LLMs via Calibration

author.name: Yuxuan Lu, Yongkang Guo, Yuqing Kong

entry.summary: Models safety alignment in LLMs as a systematic distortion of pre-alignment distributions and casts jailbreaking as a forecast aggregation problem. Derives optimal aggregation strategy and shows logit-arithmetic methods are a special case, proposing broader family of attacks.

entry.title: Good SFT Optimizes for SFT, Better SFT Prepares for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dylan Zhang, Yufeng Xu, Haojin Wang, Qingzhi Chen, Hao Peng

entry.summary: Demonstrates that stronger SFT checkpoints can significantly underperform weaker ones after identical RL training due to distribution mismatch. Proposes PEAR to re-weight SFT samples to prepare for RL.

entry.title: A Relative-Budget Theory for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards in Large Language Model Reasoning

author.name: Akifumi Wachi, Hirota Kinoshita, Shokichi Takakura, Rei Higuchi, Taiji Suzuki

entry.summary: Proposes relative-budget theory explaining RL effectiveness for LLM reasoning through ξ=H/E[T]. Identifies three regimes: deficient (rare informative trajectories), efficient, and wasteful.

entry.title: SafePred: A Predictive Guardrail for Computer-Using Agents via World Models

author.name: Yurun Chen, Zeyi Liao, Ping Yin, Taotao Xie, Keting Yin, Shengyu Zhang

entry.summary: SafePred introduces predictive guardrails for computer-using agents using world models to proactively identify long-term risks from seemingly reasonable actions, unlike reactive guardrails that only detect immediate threats.

entry.title: High-accuracy sampling for diffusion models and log-concave distributions

author.name: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Constantinos Daskalakis, Alexander Rakhlin

entry.summary: Presents algorithms achieving δ-error in polylog(1/δ) steps for diffusion model sampling, exponential improvement over prior work. Also yields first polylog complexity sampler for strongly log-concave distributions.

entry.title: How Implicit Bias Accumulates and Propagates in LLM Long-term Memory

author.name: Yiming Ma, Lixu Wang, Lionel Z. Wang, Hongkun Yang, Haoming Sun, Xin Xu, Jiaqi Wu, Bin Chen, Wei Dong

entry.summary: Studies how implicit bias accumulates and propagates in LLMs with long-term memory mechanisms. Introduces DIB Benchmark with 3,776 decision-making scenarios across 9 domains, evaluating 6 SOTA LLMs with 3 memory architectures.

entry.title: Transformers learn factored representations

author.name: Adam Shai, Loren Amdahl-Culleton, Casper L. Christensen, Henry R. Bigelow, Fernando E. Rosas, Alexander B. Boyd, Eric A. Alt, Kyle J. Ray, Paul M. Riechers

entry.summary: Formalizes how transformers pretrained via next-token prediction learn factored representations in orthogonal subspaces of the residual stream. Derives precise geometric predictions about activation structure and validates empirically.

entry.title: Towards Long-Horizon Interpretability: Efficient and Faithful Multi-Token Attribution for Reasoning LLMs

author.name: Wenbo Pan, Zhichao Liu, Xianlong Wang, Haining Yu, Xiaohua Jia

entry.summary: Introduces FlashTrace for efficient multi-token attribution in reasoning LLMs, reducing complexity from O(M*N) to O(N) through span-wise aggregation. Addresses attribution mass absorption by intermediate reasoning tokens.

entry.title: Adversarial Reward Auditing for Active Detection and Mitigation of Reward Hacking

author.name: Mohammad Beigi, Ming Jin, Junshan Zhang, Qifan Wang, Lifu Huang

entry.summary: Adversarial Reward Auditing (ARA) reconceptualizes reward hacking as dynamic adversarial game where Hacker policy discovers vulnerabilities while Auditor detects exploitation, enabling Auditor-Guided RLHF.

entry.title: The Blessing of Dimensionality in LLM Fine-tuning: A Variance-Curvature Perspective

author.name: Qiyao Liang, Jinyeop Song, Yizhou Liu, Jeff Gore, Ila Fiete, Risto Miikkulainen, Xin Qiu

entry.summary: Explains why evolution strategies can fine-tune billion-parameter LLMs with small populations (~30) through a variance-curvature perspective. Shows fine-tuning landscapes are low-dimensional in curvature.

entry.title: TQL: Scaling Q-Functions with Transformers by Preventing Attention Collapse

author.name: Perry Dong, Kuo-Han Hung, Alexander Swerdlow, Dorsa Sadigh, Chelsea Finn

entry.summary: Identifies attention collapse as the critical failure mode preventing transformer scaling for RL value functions. Proposes TQL controlling attention entropy to enable larger models.

entry.title: What Do Agents Learn from Trajectory-SFT: Semantics or Interfaces?

author.name: Weizheng Gu, Chengze Li, Zhuohao Yu, Mengyuan Sun, Zhibang Yang, Wei Wang, Hongrui Jia, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye

entry.summary: Introduces PIPE protocol to diagnose whether agents learn semantic tool-use or merely memorize interface patterns. Testing across 16 environments reveals trajectory-SFT substantially amplifies interface reliance over semantic understanding.

entry.title: DASH: Faster Shampoo via Batched Block Preconditioning and Efficient Inverse-Root Solvers

author.name: Ionut-Vlad Modoranu, Philip Zmushko, Erik Schultheis, Mher Safaryan, Dan Alistarh

entry.summary: Proposes DASH for faster Shampoo optimizer via batched block preconditioning in 3D tensors and Newton-DB iteration for inverse roots. Significant speedup over distributed Shampoo.

entry.title: Expanding the Capabilities of Reinforcement Learning via Text Feedback

author.name: Yuda Song, Lili Chen, Fahim Tajwar, Remi Munos, Deepak Pathak, J. Andrew Bagnell, Aarti Singh, Andrea Zanette

entry.summary: Studies text feedback as an intermediate signal between scalar rewards and demonstrations for RL. Formalizes RL from Text Feedback (RLTF) as multi-turn RL setup where text critiques are available during training.

entry.title: Hallucination is a Consequence of Space-Optimality: A Rate-Distortion Theorem for Membership Testing

author.name: Anxin Guo, Jingwei Li

entry.summary: Establishes rate-distortion theorem formalizing hallucination as consequence of space-optimality in membership testing. Shows optimal memory efficiency characterized by minimum KL divergence, explaining hallucination as information-theoretically fundamental.

entry.title: A Provable Expressiveness Hierarchy in Hybrid Linear-Full Attention

author.name: Xiaowei Ye, Xiaoyu He, Chao Liao, Chen Wu, Pinyan Lu

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical expressiveness hierarchy showing full attention > hybrid attention > linear attention for sequential function composition (multi-step reasoning), proving linear attention variants cannot match full attention on specific tasks.

entry.title: Chance-Constrained Inference for Hallucination Risk Control in Large Language Models

author.name: Sreenivasan Mohandas

entry.summary: Formulates LLM inference as a deployment-time risk control problem and introduces chance-constrained inference to bound hallucination probability. Proposes sequential, anytime-valid algorithm providing statistical guarantees on accepted generations.

entry.title: Learning While Staying Curious: Entropy-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning via Adaptive Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Hao Wang, Hao Gu, Hongming Piao, Kaixiong Gong, Yuxiao Ye, Xiangyu Yue, Sirui Han, Yike Guo, Dapeng Wu

entry.summary: Proposes CurioSFT entropy-preserving SFT method with Self-Exploratory Distillation to maintain exploration capability for subsequent RL, addressing overconfidence from standard SFT.

entry.title: An Empirical Study on Noisy Data and LLM Pretraining Loss Divergence

author.name: Qizhen Zhang, Ankush Garg, Jakob Foerster, Niladri Chatterji, Kshitiz Malik, Mike Lewis

entry.summary: Systematic empirical study on how noisy data causes LLM pretraining loss divergence across models from 480M to 5.2B parameters. Shows that noise injection leads to predictable instability patterns and divergence thresholds.

entry.title: How RLHF Amplifies Sycophancy

author.name: Itai Shapira, Gerdus Benade, Ariel D. Procaccia

entry.summary: Provides formal analysis of how RLHF amplifies sycophancy, identifying explicit mechanism linking reward optimization to bias in preference data. Shows behavioral drift depends on covariance under base policy.

entry.title: Building Better Deception Probes Using Targeted Instruction Pairs

author.name: Vikram Natarajan, Devina Jain, Shivam Arora, Satvik Golechha, Joseph Bloom

entry.summary: Shows that targeted instruction pairs using human-interpretable taxonomy of deception types significantly improves linear probes for detecting AI deceptive behavior compared to generic approaches.

entry.title: Simple Role Assignment is Extraordinarily Effective for Safety Alignment

author.name: Zhou Ziheng, Jiakun Ding, Zhaowei Zhang, Ruosen Gao, Yingnian Wu, Demetri Terzopoulos, Yipeng Kang, Fangwei Zhong, Junqi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes role conditioning as compact alternative to principle-based alignment, using social roles (mother, judge) to implicitly encode values. Achieves dramatic reduction in unsafe outputs from 81.4% to 3.6% on WildJailbreak with DeepSeek-V3.

entry.title: Beyond the Loss Curve: Scaling Laws, Active Learning, and the Limits of Learning from Exact Posteriors

author.name: Arian Khorasani, Nathaniel Chen, Yug D Oswal, Akshat Santhana Gopalan, Egemen Kolemen, Ravid Shwartz-Ziv

entry.summary: Uses class-conditional normalizing flows as oracles with exact posteriors to study scaling laws, decomposing error into aleatoric and epistemic components. Shows architectural differences in approaching aleatoric floor.

entry.title: ZEST: Zero-shot Embodied Skill Transfer for Athletic Robot Control

author.name: Jean Pierre Sleiman, He Li, Alphonsus Adu-Bredu, Robin Deits, Arun Kumar, Kevin Bergamin, Mohak Bhardwaj, Scott Biddlestone, Nicola Burger, Matthew A. Estrada, Francesco Iacobelli, Twan Koolen, Alexander Lambert, Erica Lin, M. Eva Mungai, Zach Nobles, Shane Rozen-Levy, Yuyao Shi, Jiashun Wang, Jakob Welner, Fangzhou Yu, Mike Zhang, Alfred Rizzi, Jessica Hodgins, Sylvain Bertrand, Yeuhi Abe, Scott Kuindersma, Farbod Farshidian

entry.summary: ZEST enables zero-shot transfer of athletic behaviors to humanoid robots from diverse motion sources (mocap, video, animation) via RL without contact labels, state estimators, or extensive reward shaping.

entry.title: Rethinking Hallucinations: Correctness, Consistency, and Prompt Multiplicity

author.name: Prakhar Ganesh, Reza Shokri, Golnoosh Farnadi

entry.summary: Introduces prompt multiplicity framework for quantifying consistency in LLM hallucination evaluations. Reveals over 50% inconsistency in benchmarks like Med-HALT and studies consistency's role in hallucination detection and mitigation.

entry.title: MarkovScale: Towards Optimal Sequential Scaling at Inference Time

author.name: Youkang Wang, Jian Wang, Rubing Chen, Tianyi Zeng, Xiao-Yong Wei, Qing Li

entry.summary: Models sequential inference-time scaling as a two-state Markov process, deriving closed-form solutions for performance bounds and conditions for accuracy improvement. Proposes MarkovScale system.

entry.title: Provable Defense Framework for LLM Jailbreaks via Noise-Augumented Alignment

author.name: Zehua Cheng, Jianwei Yang, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes certifiable defense against LLM jailbreaks via Certified Semantic Smoothing using stratified randomized ablation with Noise-Augmented Alignment Tuning for semantic denoising.

entry.title: A Practical Tensor-Network Compression Pipeline for Production-Scale Large Language Models

author.name: Sergii Kozyrev (Minima AI, Inc.), Davyd Maiboroda (Minima AI, Inc.)

entry.summary: Minima presents a production-ready LLM compression pipeline using tensor decomposition (Tucker, tensor-train, tensor-ring) with sensitivity prediction, healing fine-tuning, and custom kernels. Achieves 64GB→<32GB VRAM reduction on Qwen3-32B.

entry.title: SWE-Universe: Scale Real-World Verifiable Environments to Millions

author.name: Mouxiang Chen, Lei Zhang, Yunlong Feng, Xuwu Wang, Wenting Zhao, Ruisheng Cao, Jiaxi Yang, Jiawei Chen, Mingze Li, Zeyao Ma, Hao Ge, Zongmeng Zhang, Zeyu Cui, Dayiheng Liu, Jingren Zhou, Jianling Sun, Junyang Lin, Binyuan Hui

entry.summary: SWE-Universe framework automatically constructs 807,693 real-world multilingual software engineering environments from GitHub PRs using building agent with iterative self-verification and hacking detection.

entry.title: Nearly Optimal Active Preference Learning and Its Application to LLM Alignment

author.name: Yao Zhao, Kwang-Sung Jun

entry.summary: Proposes two active learning algorithms for preference learning with instance-dependent label complexity guarantees. Shows classical experimental design criteria (G/D-optimality) are suboptimal for preference learning's specific structure.

entry.title: Statistical Learning Theory in Lean 4: Empirical Processes from Scratch

author.name: Yuanhe Zhang, Jason D. Lee, Fanghui Liu

entry.summary: Presents the first comprehensive Lean 4 formalization of statistical learning theory, including Gaussian Lipschitz concentration and Dudley's entropy integral theorem. Uses a human-AI collaborative workflow where humans design proof strategies and AI executes tactical construction.

entry.title: Expected Harm: Rethinking Safety Evaluation of (Mis)Aligned LLMs

author.name: Yen-Shan Chen, Zhi Rui Tam, Cheng-Kuang Wu, Yun-Nung Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Expected Harm metric for LLM safety that weights severity by Execution Likelihood. Reveals systematic Inverse Risk Calibration where models refuse low-likelihood threats but remain vulnerable to high-likelihood ones.

entry.title: Temporal Leakage in Search-Engine Date-Filtered Web Retrieval: A Case Study from Retrospective Forecasting

author.name: Ali El Lahib, Ying-Jieh Xia, Zehan Li, Yuxuan Wang, Xinyu Pi

entry.summary: Reveals that 71% of date-filtered Google Search queries return post-cutoff leakage, with 41% directly revealing answers. Demonstrates inflated forecasting accuracy (Brier 0.108 vs 0.242) when using leaked documents.

entry.title: Simplicity Prevails: The Emergence of Generalizable AIGI Detection in Visual Foundation Models

author.name: Yue Zhou, Xinan He, Kaiqing Lin, Bing Fan, Feng Ding, Bin Li

entry.summary: Demonstrates that simple linear classifiers on frozen Vision Foundation Model features (Perception Encoder, MetaCLIP 2, DINOv3) establish new SOTA for AI-generated image detection, outperforming specialized detectors on in-the-wild data.

entry.title: Structure Enables Effective Self-Localization of Errors in LLMs

author.name: Ankur Samanta, Akshayaa Magesh, Ayush Jain, Kavosh Asadi, Youliang Yu, Daniel Jiang, Boris Vidolov, Kaveh Hassani, Paul Sajda, Jalaj Bhandari, Yonathan Efroni

entry.summary: Shows structured reasoning as discrete thought steps enables reliable error self-localization in LLMs, proposing Thought-ICS for iterative correction sampling inspired by human brain error monitoring.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Teams Hold Experts Back

author.name: Aneesh Pappu, Batu El, Hancheng Cao, Carmelo di Nolfo, Yanchao Sun, Meng Cao, James Zou

entry.summary: Studies whether self-organizing LLM teams achieve synergy comparable to human teams. Finds that unlike human teams, multi-agent LLM systems fail to match or exceed best individual member performance.

entry.title: P-EAGLE: Parallel-Drafting EAGLE with Scalable Training

author.name: Mude Hui, Xin Huang, Jaime Campos Salas, Yue Sun, Nathan Pemberton, Xiang Song, Ashish Khetan, George Karypis

entry.summary: Proposes P-EAGLE transforming EAGLE from autoregressive to parallel multi-token prediction via shared hidden state, with scalable training framework for long-context reasoning LLMs.

entry.title: Human Society-Inspired Approaches to Agentic AI Security: The 4C Framework

author.name: Alsharif Abuadbba, Nazatul Sultan, Surya Nepal, Sanjay Jha

entry.summary: Proposes 4C Framework (Containment, Coordination, Compliance, Consensus) for agentic AI security, inspired by human society mechanisms for governing autonomous actors in complex ecosystems.

entry.title: MSign: An Optimizer Preventing Training Instability in Large Language Models via Stable Rank Restoration

author.name: Lianhai Ren, Yucheng Ding, Xiao Liu, Qianxiao Li, Peng Cheng, Yeyun Gong

entry.summary: Identifies that training instability in LLMs is preceded by declining weight matrix stable rank and increasing layer Jacobian alignment. Proposes MSign optimizer that periodically applies matrix sign operations to restore stable rank.

entry.title: Omni-RRM: Advancing Omni Reward Modeling via Automatic Rubric-Grounded Preference Synthesis

author.name: Zicheng Kong, Dehua Ma, Zhenbo Xu, Alven Yang, Yiwei Ru, Haoran Wang, Zixuan Zhou, Fuqing Bie, Liuyu Xiang, Huijia Wu, Jian Zhao, Zhaofeng He

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-RRM, the first open-source rubric-grounded reward model producing structured multi-dimension judgments with justifications across text, image, video, and audio modalities.

entry.title: ProjDevBench: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents on End-to-End Project Development

author.name: Pengrui Lu, Shiqi Zhang, Yunzhong Hou, Lyumanshan Ye, Chaoyi Huang, Zixi Chen, Ji Zeng, Hantao Jiang, Pengfei Liu, Yiwei Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: ProjDevBench benchmarks coding agents on end-to-end project development from requirements to full repositories, evaluating architecture design, functional correctness, and iterative refinement across 20 problems.

entry.title: Mitigating Safety Tax via Distribution-Grounded Refinement in Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Yingsha Xie, Tiansheng Huang, Enneng Yang, Rui Min, Wenjie Lu, Xiaochun Cao, Naiqiang Tan, Li Shen

entry.summary: DGR addresses safety tax in reasoning models by transforming out-of-distribution safety datasets to align with target LRM's inner distribution, mitigating reasoning ability degradation.

entry.title: MCP-Atlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Tool-Use Competency with Real MCP Servers

author.name: Chaithanya Bandi, Ben Hertzberg, Geobio Boo, Tejas Polakam, Jeff Da, Sami Hassaan, Manasi Sharma, Andrew Park, Ernesto Hernandez, Dan Rambado, Ivan Salazar, Rafael Cruz, Chetan Rane, Ben Levin, Brad Kenstler, Bing Liu

entry.summary: Introduces MCP-Atlas benchmark for evaluating tool-use competency with 36 real MCP servers, 220 tools, and 1000 tasks requiring 3-6 tool calls across multiple servers. Uses natural language prompts without naming specific tools.

entry.title: You Need an Encoder for Native Position-Independent Caching

author.name: Shiju Zhao, Junhao Hu, Jiaqi Zheng, Guihai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes reintroducing encoders to decoder-only LLMs for native position-independent caching, enabling KV reuse without positional constraints. COMB system reduces TTFT by 51-94%.

entry.title: RedVisor: Reasoning-Aware Prompt Injection Defense via Zero-Copy KV Cache Reuse

author.name: Mingrui Liu, Sixiao Zhang, Cheng Long, Kwok-Yan Lam

entry.summary: RedVisor defends against prompt injection using reasoning-aware zero-copy KV cache reuse, leveraging fine-grained reasoning paths to simultaneously detect attacks and guide safe responses without fine-tuning penalty.

entry.title: $\textbf{AGT$^{AO}$}$: Robust and Stabilized LLM Unlearning via Adversarial Gating Training with Adaptive Orthogonality

author.name: Pengyu Li, Lingling Zhang, Zhitao Gao, Yanrui Wu, Yuxuan Dong, Huan Liu, Bifan Wei, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes AGT^AO for LLM unlearning that reconciles robust erasure with utility preservation through adversarial gating training and adaptive orthogonality. Addresses catastrophic forgetting vs superficial forgetting tradeoff.

entry.title: Prism: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification for Discrete Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Jinbin Bai, Yixuan Li, Yuchen Zhu, Yi Xin, Qingyu Shi, Aosong Feng, Xiaohong Liu, Molei Tao, Jianru Xue, Xiangtai Li, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Prism, a test-time scaling framework for discrete diffusion language models using hierarchical trajectory search, local branching with partial remasking, and self-verification.

entry.title: Hessian Spectral Analysis at Foundation Model Scale

author.name: Diego Granziol, Khurshid Juarev

entry.summary: First large-scale Hessian spectral analysis of foundation models up to 100B parameters using shard-local finite-difference with FSDP. Characterizes numerical behavior and derives practical operating regions.

entry.title: Causal Forcing: Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation Done Right for High-Quality Real-Time Interactive Video Generation

author.name: Hongzhou Zhu, Min Zhao, Guande He, Hang Su, Chongxuan Li, Jun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes Causal Forcing for autoregressive diffusion distillation, identifying that bidirectional-to-AR distillation violates frame-level injectivity causing conditional-expectation degradation.

entry.title: Assessing Domain-Level Susceptibility to Emergent Misalignment from Narrow Finetuning

author.name: Abhishek Mishra, Mugilan Arulvanan, Reshma Ashok, Polina Petrova, Deepesh Suranjandass, Donnie Winkelmann

entry.summary: Studies emergent misalignment from finetuning on insecure data across 11 domains, finding backdoor triggers increase misalignment in 77.8% of domains. Tests Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and GPT-4o-mini, revealing domain-specific vulnerability patterns.

entry.title: Self-Guard: Defending Large Reasoning Models via enhanced self-reflection

author.name: Jingnan Zheng, Jingjun Xu, Yanzhen Luo, Chenhang Cui, Gelei Deng, Zhenkai Liang, Xiang Wang, An Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Guard framework for defending Large Reasoning Models against risks like reasoning manipulation and information leakage. Addresses awareness-compliance gap where models recognize risks but follow harmful instructions anyway.

entry.title: HalluHard: A Hard Multi-Turn Hallucination Benchmark

author.name: Dongyang Fan, Sebastien Delsad, Nicolas Flammarion, Maksym Andriushchenko

entry.summary: Introduces HalluHard, challenging multi-turn hallucination benchmark with 950 questions across legal, research, medical, and coding domains. Uses citation-based groundedness with web search verification.

entry.title: Legal Infrastructure for Transformative AI Governance

author.name: Gillian K. Hadfield

entry.summary: PNAS Perspective piece arguing AI governance needs to focus on legal/regulatory infrastructure, not just substantive rules, proposing registration regimes for frontier models, autonomous agents, and regulatory markets.

entry.title: Understanding the Reversal Curse Mitigation in Masked Diffusion Models through Attention and Training Dynamics

author.name: Sangwoo Shin, BumJun Kim, Kyelim Lee, Moongyu Jeon, Albert No

entry.summary: Explains why Masked Diffusion Models mitigate reversal curse better than autoregressive models, showing it arises from architectural weight sharing coupling forward and reverse directions, not just any-order training.
