entry.summary: ClueTracer identifies 'reasoning drift' in multimodal reasoning models and proposes training-free hallucination suppression by tracing question-to-vision clues, addressing over-focus on irrelevant entities.

entry.title: Unifying Masked Diffusion Models with Various Generation Orders and Beyond

author.name: Chunsan Hong, Sanghyun Lee, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: OeMDM provides a unified framework for masked diffusion models with various generation orders, enabling interpretation of MDMs, autoregressive models, and block diffusion in a single framework, plus LoMDM which jointly learns generation order during training.

entry.title: OmniCode: A Benchmark for Evaluating Software Engineering Agents

author.name: Atharv Sonwane, Eng-Shen Tu, Wei-Chung Lu, Claas Beger, Carter Larsen, Debjit Dhar, Rachel Chen, Ronit Pattanayak, Tuan Anh Dang, Guohao Chen, Gloria Geng, Kevin Ellis, Saikat Dutta

entry.summary: OmniCode benchmark contains 1794 tasks spanning broader software engineering activities beyond code/patch generation, addressing the gap between narrow coding benchmarks and real-world development needs.

entry.title: Infinite-World: Scaling Interactive World Models to 1000-Frame Horizons via Pose-Free Hierarchical Memory

author.name: Ruiqi Wu, Xuanhua He, Meng Cheng, Tianyu Yang, Yong Zhang, Zhuoliang Kang, Xunliang Cai, Xiaoming Wei, Chunle Guo, Chongyi Li, Ming-Ming Cheng

entry.summary: Infinite-World maintains coherent visual memory over 1000+ frames through Hierarchical Pose-free Memory Compressor that recursively distills historical latents into fixed-budget representation without requiring ground-truth poses.

entry.title: On the Relationship Between Representation Geometry and Generalization in Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Sumit Yadav

entry.summary: Investigates representation geometry's relationship to neural network performance across 52 ImageNet models and extends to NLP. Shows effective dimension strongly predicts accuracy (partial r=0.75) independent of model size.

entry.title: Towards Building Non-Fine-Tunable Foundation Models

author.name: Ziyao Wang, Nizhang Li, Pingzhi Li, Guoheng Sun, Tianlong Chen, Ang Li

entry.summary: Proposes non-fine-tunable foundation models via Private Mask Pre-Training, concentrating learning in sparse subnetwork with private mask. Forces unauthorized fine-tuning to update misaligned parameters, limiting adaptation.

entry.title: Spectral Imbalance Causes Forgetting in Low-Rank Continual Adaptation

author.name: Hao Gu, Mao-Lin Luo, Zi-Hao Zhou, Han-Chen Zhang, Min-Ling Zhang, Tong Wei

entry.summary: Identifies spectral imbalance in low-rank adaptations as a root cause of catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. Shows that dominant singular components both disrupt prior knowledge and make updates vulnerable to subsequent interference.

entry.title: SALAAD: Sparse And Low-Rank Adaptation via ADMM

author.name: Hao Ma, Melis Ilayda Bal, Liang Zhang, Bingcong Li, Niao He, Melanie Zeilinger, Michael Muehlebach

entry.summary: Proposes SALAAD, a plug-and-play framework inducing sparse and low-rank structures during training via augmented Lagrangian with adaptive controller for constraint balancing.

entry.title: SAGE: Agentic Framework for Interpretable and Clinically Translatable Computational Pathology Biomarker Discovery

author.name: Sahar Almahfouz Nasser, Juan Francisco Pesantez Borja, Jincheng Liu, Tanvir Hasan, Zenghan Wang, Suman Ghosh, Sandeep Manandhar, Shikhar Shiromani, Twisha Shah, Naoto Tokuyama, Anant Madabhushi

entry.summary: Introduces SAGE, an agentic AI system for discovering interpretable computational pathology biomarkers grounded in biological evidence. Integrates literature-anchored reasoning with multimodal data analysis.

entry.title: TRACE: Scalable Amortized Causal Discovery from Single Sequences via Autoregressive Density Estimation

author.name: Hugo Math, Rainer Lienhart

entry.summary: Introduces TRACE for causal discovery from single event sequences using autoregressive models as pretrained density estimators for conditional mutual information. Scales linearly with vocabulary and supports GPU parallelism.

entry.title: Unraveling the Hidden Dynamical Structure in Recurrent Neural Policies

author.name: Jin Li, Yue Wu, Mengsha Huang, Yuhao Sun, Hao He, Xianyuan Zhan

entry.summary: Discovers that stable cyclic structures (limit cycles) consistently emerge in hidden states of recurrent neural policies across architectures and tasks, providing mechanistic explanation for generalization.

entry.title: MiTA Attention: Efficient Fast-Weight Scaling via a Mixture of Top-$k$ Activations

author.name: Qishuai Wen, Zhiyuan Huang, Xianghan Meng, Wei He, Chun-Guang Li

entry.summary: Proposes MiTA attention viewing attention as fast-weight MLP and introducing mixture of top-k activations for efficient scaling. Unifies various efficient attention methods under routing/compression framework.

entry.title: Mixture-of-World Models: Scaling Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Modular Latent Dynamics

author.name: Boxuan Zhang, Weipu Zhang, Zhaohan Feng, Wei Xiao, Jian Sun, Jie Chen, Gang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Mixture-of-World Models for multi-task RL combining modular VAEs, hybrid Transformer dynamics with task-conditioned experts, and gradient-based task clustering.

entry.title: Imperfect Influence, Preserved Rankings: A Theory of TRAK for Data Attribution

author.name: Han Tong, Shubhangi Ghosh, Haolin Zou, Arian Maleki

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of TRAK data attribution algorithm, characterizing when approximations are accurate and quantifying errors. Shows rankings are preserved even when influence estimates are imperfect.

entry.title: Improve the Trade-off Between Watermark Strength and Speculative Sampling Efficiency for Language Models

author.name: Weiqing He, Xiang Li, Li Shen, Weijie Su, Qi Long

entry.summary: Analyzes watermark strength vs speculative sampling efficiency trade-off, showing it's not absolute. Introduces quantitative measure maximized when tokens are deterministic functions of pseudorandom numbers.

entry.title: A Statistical Theory of Gated Attention through the Lens of Hierarchical Mixture of Experts

author.name: Viet Nguyen, Tuan Minh Pham, Thinh Cao, Tan Dinh, Huy Nguyen, Nhat Ho, Alessandro Rinaldo

entry.summary: Provides statistical theory of gated attention through hierarchical mixture of experts lens, showing gated attention entries can be viewed as hierarchical MoE. Explains benefits over standard attention.

entry.title: Revisiting Generalization Measures Beyond IID: An Empirical Study under Distributional Shift

author.name: Sora Nakai, Youssef Fadhloun, Kacem Mathlouthi, Kotaro Yoshida, Ganesh Talluri, Ioannis Mitliagkas, Hiroki Naganuma

entry.summary: Large-scale empirical study benchmarking 40+ generalization measures across 10,000+ hyperparameter configurations under distribution shift, extending evaluation beyond IID to synthetic and natural shifts.

entry.title: No Generation without Representation: Efficient Causal Protein Language Models Enable Zero-Shot Fitness Estimation

author.name: Furkan Eris

entry.summary: Introduces Proust, a 309M-parameter causal protein language model achieving competitive fitness prediction (Spearman ρ=0.390) with MLMs while enabling generation, using LLM architectural innovations.

entry.title: STILL: Selecting Tokens for Intra-Layer Hybrid Attention to Linearize LLMs

author.name: Weikang Meng, Liangyu Huo, Yadan Luo, Jiawen Guan, Jingyi Zhang, Yingjian Li, Zheng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes STILL for linearizing pretrained LLMs via Self-Saliency Score with local-global consistency for token selection and distribution-preserving linear attention.

entry.title: EvalQReason: A Framework for Step-Level Reasoning Evaluation in Large Language Models

author.name: Shaima Ahmad Freja, Ferhat Ozgur Catak, Betul Yurdem, Chunming Rong

entry.summary: EvalQReason quantifies LLM reasoning quality through step-level probability distribution analysis without human annotation. Introduces metrics for measuring local coherence between steps (CSD) and global alignment with final answers (SFC).

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Learning via Conformal Shapley Intervals

author.name: Mathew Chandy, Michael Johnson, Judong Shen, Devan V. Mehrotra, Hua Zhou, Jin Zhou, Xiaowu Dai

entry.summary: Conformal Shapley intervals combine Shapley values with conformal inference to construct uncertainty-aware importance intervals for each modality in multimodal learning, with provable optimality guarantees.

entry.title: Inference-Aware Meta-Alignment of LLMs via Non-Linear GRPO

author.name: Shokichi Takakura, Akifumi Wachi, Rei Higuchi, Kohei Miyaguchi, Taiji Suzuki

entry.summary: Proposes inference-aware meta-alignment (IAMA) enabling LLMs to be aligned to multiple criteria with limited compute at inference time via non-linear GRPO. Pre-trains base model for effective multi-task alignment.

entry.title: Transformers as Measure-Theoretic Associative Memory: A Statistical Perspective and Minimax Optimality

author.name: Ryotaro Kawata, Taiji Suzuki

entry.summary: Recasts transformers as measure-theoretic associative memory, showing softmax attention learns recall-and-predict map from mixture contexts. Proves minimax optimality for learned attention.

entry.title: Ultrafast On-chip Online Learning via Spline Locality in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Duc Hoang, Aarush Gupta, Philip Harris

entry.summary: Demonstrates KANs enable ultrafast on-chip online learning by exploiting B-spline locality for sparse updates and robustness to fixed-point quantization. Implements on FPGA.

entry.title: Faithful-Patchscopes: Understanding and Mitigating Model Bias in Hidden Representations Explanation of Large Language Models

author.name: Xilin Gong, Shu Yang, Zehua Cao, Lynne Billard, Di Wang

entry.summary: Reveals systematic unfaithfulness in Patchscopes where LLMs override encoded contextual information with prior linguistic associations during interpretation. Proposes Faithful-Patchscopes to mitigate this bias.

entry.title: Distilling Token-Trained Models into Byte-Level Models

author.name: Zishuo Bao, Jiaqi Leng, Junxiong Wang, Bowen Peng, Yucheng Lu

entry.summary: Proposes efficient distillation recipe for converting token-trained LLMs to byte-level models through progressive knowledge distillation and byte-level SFT. Validates across Llama and Qwen families.

entry.title: Balancing Understanding and Generation in Discrete Diffusion Models

author.name: Yue Liu, Yuzhong Zhao, Zheyong Xie, Qixiang Ye, Jianbin Jiao, Yao Hu, Shaosheng Cao, Yunfan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes XDLM unifying Masked and Uniform-noise diffusion language models via stationary noise kernel, recovering each as special case. Provides algebraic simplification reducing memory bottleneck.

entry.title: From Latent Signals to Reflection Behavior: Tracing Meta-Cognitive Activation Trajectory in R1-Style LLMs

author.name: Yanrui Du, Yibo Gao, Sendong Zhao, Jiayun Li, Haochun Wang, Qika Lin, Kai He, Bing Qin, Mengling Feng

entry.summary: Analyzes internal mechanisms of R1-style LLMs during self-reflection, identifying three-phase activation trajectory: latent-control layers encoding thinking budget, semantic-pivot layers for discourse cues, and behavior-overt layers for reflection tokens.

entry.title: DuoGen: Towards General Purpose Interleaved Multimodal Generation

author.name: Min Shi, Xiaohui Zeng, Jiannan Huang, Yin Cui, Francesco Ferroni, Jialuo Li, Shubham Pachori, Zhaoshuo Li, Yogesh Balaji, Haoxiang Wang, Tsung-Yi Lin, Xiao Fu, Yue Zhao, Chieh-Yun Chen, Ming-Yu Liu, Humphrey Shi

entry.summary: DuoGen framework for interleaved multimodal generation addresses data curation, architecture design, and evaluation. Uses large-scale instruction-tuning dataset from curated websites and synthetic examples.

entry.title: MedAD-R1: Eliciting Consistent Reasoning in Interpretible Medical Anomaly Detection via Consistency-Reinforced Policy Optimization

author.name: Haitao Zhang, Yingying Wang, Jiaxiang Wang, Haote Xu, Hongyang Zhang, Yirong Chen, Yue Huang, Xinghao Ding

entry.summary: Introduces MedAD-38K, first large-scale multi-modal medical anomaly detection benchmark with CoT annotations, and proposes two-stage training with cognitive injection and consistency-reinforced policy optimization.

entry.title: Fact or Fake? Assessing the Role of Deepfake Detectors in Multimodal Misinformation Detection

author.name: A S M Sharifuzzaman Sagar, Mohammed Bennamoun, Farid Boussaid, Naeha Sharif, Lian Xu, Shaaban Sahmoud, Ali Kishk

entry.summary: Provides first systematic analysis of whether pixel-level deepfake detectors contribute useful signal for multimodal misinformation detection, finding they can introduce misleading priors.

entry.title: UniDriveDreamer: A Single-Stage Multimodal World Model for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Guosheng Zhao, Yaozeng Wang, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu, Tingdong Yu, Guan Huang, Yongchen Zai, Ji Jiao, Changliang Xue, Xiaole Wang, Zhen Yang, Futang Zhu, Xingang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces UniDriveDreamer, a single-stage unified multimodal world model for autonomous driving that generates both multi-camera video and LiDAR sequences without intermediate representations.

entry.title: Latent Reasoning VLA: Latent Thinking and Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Shuanghao Bai, Jing Lyu, Wanqi Zhou, Zhe Li, Dakai Wang, Lei Xing, Xiaoguang Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Cheng Chi, Badong Chen, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces LaRA-VLA, internalizing chain-of-thought reasoning into continuous latent representations for VLA models, eliminating explicit CoT generation at inference.

entry.title: Learning Modal-Mixed Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Latent Embeddings

author.name: Yifei Shao, Kun Zhou, Ziming Xu, Mohammad Atif Quamar, Shibo Hao, Zhen Wang, Zhiting Hu, Biwei Huang

entry.summary: Introduces modal-mixed CoT interleaving text with visual sketches as latent embeddings for multimodal reasoning. Uses VLM as encoder with diffusion-based decoder to bridge modality gap without eroding original capabilities.

entry.title: MindGuard: Guardrail Classifiers for Multi-Turn Mental Health Support

author.name: Ant\'onio Farinhas, Nuno M. Guerreiro, Jos\'e Pombal, Pedro Henrique Martins, Laura Melton, Alex Conway, Cara Dochat, Maya D'Eon, Ricardo Rei

entry.summary: Introduces clinically grounded risk taxonomy for mental health AI with MindGuard-testset of expert-annotated multi-turn conversations. Distinguishes therapeutic disclosures from clinical crises.

entry.title: Probing RLVR training instability through the lens of objective-level hacking

author.name: Yiming Dong, Kun Fu, Haoyu Li, Xinyuan Zhu, Yurou Liu, Lijing Shao, Jieping Ye, Zheng Wang

entry.summary: Analyzes RLVR training instability through objective-level hacking framework, showing it emerges from token-level credit misalignment as spurious optimization signals. Focuses on MoE architecture failures.

entry.title: Workflow-R1: Group Sub-sequence Policy Optimization for Multi-turn Workflow Construction

author.name: Mingze Kong, Zikun Qu, Zhongquan Zhou, Pengyu Liang, Xiang Li, Zhiwei Shang, Zhi Hong, Kaiyu Huang, Zhiyong Wang, Zhongxiang Dai

entry.summary: Presents Workflow-R1, reformulating agentic workflow construction as multi-turn natural language decision-making instead of one-shot code generation. Introduces Group Sub-sequence Policy Optimization (GSsPO) for optimization.

entry.title: Mitigating loss of control in advanced AI systems through instrumental goal trajectories

author.name: Willem Fourie

entry.summary: Develops instrumental goal trajectories framework for mitigating AI loss of control by tracking how advanced systems gain capability through accessing technical and monetary resources.

entry.title: Rethinking the Role of Entropy in Optimizing Tool-Use Behaviors for Large Language Model Agents

author.name: Zeping Li, Hongru Wang, Yiwen Zhao, Guanhua Chen, Yixia Li, Keyang Chen, Yixin Cao, Guangnan Ye, Hongfeng Chai, Mengdi Wang, Zhenfei Yin

entry.summary: Finds strong positive correlation between entropy reduction and high-quality tool calls, proposing entropy-based reward strategies with sparse outcome rewards and dense shaping rewards.

entry.title: Thinking with Comics: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning through Structured Visual Storytelling

author.name: Andong Chen, Wenxin Zhu, Qiuyu Ding, Yuchen Song, Muyun Yang, Tiejun Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Thinking with Comics as visual reasoning paradigm positioned between images and videos, preserving temporal structure and narrative coherence with lower computational cost.

entry.title: VoxServe: Streaming-Centric Serving System for Speech Language Models

author.name: Keisuke Kamahori, Wei-Tzu Lee, Atindra Jha, Rohan Kadekodi, Stephanie Wang, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Baris Kasikci

entry.summary: VoxServe is a unified serving system for speech language models with model-execution abstraction decoupling architecture from optimizations, enabling streaming-aware scheduling and async inference.

entry.title: LatentLens: Revealing Highly Interpretable Visual Tokens in LLMs

author.name: Benno Krojer, Shravan Nayak, Oscar Ma\~nas, Vaibhav Adlakha, Desmond Elliott, Siva Reddy, Marius Mosbach

entry.summary: LatentLens interprets visual tokens in VLMs by encoding large text corpus and comparing visual representations to contextualized token embeddings, revealing what information is encoded at each layer.

entry.title: Non-Contrastive Vision-Language Learning with Predictive Embedding Alignment

author.name: Lukas Kuhn, Giuseppe Serra, Florian Buettner

entry.summary: Introduces NOVA, a non-contrastive vision-language alignment framework that eliminates need for negative sampling, momentum encoders, and stop-gradients. Uses distributional regularization to maintain representation quality with a single hyperparameter.

entry.title: Neural FOXP2 -- Language Specific Neuron Steering for Targeted Language Improvement in LLMs

author.name: Anusa Saha, Tanmay Joshi, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha, Amitava Das

entry.summary: Introduces Neural FOXP2 for steering language-specific neurons to make a chosen language primary in multilingual LLMs. Uses SAEs to localize language neurons and steers them to promote Hindi or Spanish.

entry.title: Dispelling the Curse of Singularities in Neural Network Optimizations

author.name: Hengjie Cao, Mengyi Chen, Yifeng Yang, Fang Dong, Ruijun Huang, Anrui Chen, Jixian Zhou, Mingzhi Dong, Yujiang Wang, Dongsheng Li, Wenyi Fang, Yuanyi Lin, Fan Wu, Li Shang

entry.summary: Identifies 'curse of singularities'—mutual reinforcement of weight and representation singularities during training leading to loss explosions. Proposes Parametric Smoothing for prevention.

entry.title: CoDiQ: Test-Time Scaling for Controllable Difficult Question Generation

author.name: Zhongyuan Peng, Caijun Xu, Changyi Xiao, Shibo Hong, Eli Zhang, Stephen Huang, Yixin Cao

entry.summary: CoDiQ enables fine-grained difficulty control in question generation via test-time scaling, identifying that extended reasoning budget increases difficulty but reduces solvability, and deriving upper bounds on generation quality.

entry.title: IRIS: Implicit Reward-Guided Internal Sifting for Mitigating Multimodal Hallucination

author.name: Yuanshuai Li, Yuping Yan, Jirui Han, Fei Ming, Lingjuan Lv, Yaochu Jin

entry.summary: IRIS mitigates multimodal hallucination using implicit rewards in log-probability space to capture internal modal competition, enabling on-policy fine-grained optimization without external evaluators.

entry.title: Beyond RAG for Agent Memory: Retrieval by Decoupling and Aggregation

author.name: Zhanghao Hu, Qinglin Zhu, Hanqi Yan, Yulan He, Lin Gui

entry.summary: Argues agent memory should move beyond RAG similarity matching to decoupling and aggregation: disentangling memories into semantic components and organizing hierarchically for temporal coherence.

entry.title: Logic-Guided Vector Fields for Constrained Generative Modeling

author.name: Ali Baheri

entry.summary: Proposes Logic-Guided Vector Fields (LGVF) injecting symbolic constraints into flow matching generative models through differentiable logic relaxations during training and inference-time gradient steering.

entry.title: Revisiting Adaptive Rounding with Vectorized Reparameterization for LLM Quantization

author.name: Yuli Zhou, Qingxuan Chen, Luca Benini, Guolei Sun, Yawei Li

entry.summary: Proposes VQRound for efficient adaptive rounding in LLM quantization via codebook reparameterization, minimizing worst-case error under L∞ norm for heavy-tailed distributions.

entry.title: Certain Head, Uncertain Tail: Expert-Sample for Test-Time Scaling in Fine-Grained MoE

author.name: Yuanteng Chen, Peisong Wang, Nanxin Zeng, Yuantian Shao, Gang Li, Jing Liu, Jian Cheng

entry.summary: Discovers that fine-grained MoE routing exhibits a 'certain head' of high-confidence experts and 'uncertain tail' of low-confidence candidates. Proposes Expert-Sample method exploiting this pattern for test-time scaling.

entry.title: From Pixels to Facts (Pix2Fact): Benchmarking Multi-Hop Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Fact Checking

author.name: Yifan Jiang, Cong Zhang, Bofei Zhang, Yifan Yang, Bingzhang Wang, Yew-Soon Ong

entry.summary: Pix2Fact benchmark evaluates VLMs on fine-grained visual fact-checking requiring detailed grounding and multi-hop reasoning. 1,000 high-resolution images with PhD-annotated questions.

entry.title: Don't Judge a Book by its Cover: Testing LLMs' Robustness Under Logical Obfuscation

author.name: Abhilekh Borah, Shubhra Ghosh, Kedar Joshi, Aditya Kumar Guru, Kripabandhu Ghosh

entry.summary: Introduces Logifus framework for logical obfuscation and LogiQAte benchmark testing LLMs on logically equivalent but obfuscated problems. Shows LLMs fail when problems are reformulated.

entry.title: SSI-DM: Singularity Skipping Inversion of Diffusion Models

author.name: Chen Min, Enze Jiang, Jishen Peng, Zheng Ma

entry.summary: Proposes SSI-DM addressing mathematical singularity in diffusion model inversion that makes early noising steps ill-posed, achieving better Gaussian properties in inverted noise.

entry.title: AgenticLab: A Real-World Robot Agent Platform that Can See, Think, and Act

author.name: Pengyuan Guo, Zhonghao Mai, Zhengtong Xu, Kaidi Zhang, Heng Zhang, Zichen Miao, Arash Ajoudani, Zachary Kingston, Qiang Qiu, Yu She

entry.summary: Presents AgenticLab, a model-agnostic robot agent platform and benchmark for open-world VLM-based manipulation with closed-loop pipeline.

entry.title: How Far Are LLMs from Professional Poker Players? Revisiting Game-Theoretic Reasoning with Agentic Tool Use

author.name: Minhua Lin, Enyan Dai, Hui Liu, Xianfeng Tang, Yuliang Yan, Zhenwei Dai, Jingying Zeng, Zhiwei Zhang, Fali Wang, Hongcheng Gao, Chen Luo, Xiang Zhang, Qi He, Suhang Wang

entry.title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement for Reasoning Large Language Models via Dynamic One-Shot Policy Refinement

author.name: Yunjian Zhang, Sudong Wang, Yang Li, Peiran Xu, Conghao Zhou, Xiaoyue Ma, Jianing Li, Yao Zhu

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical lower bound on sample complexity for RLVR reasoning and proposes dynamic one-shot policy refinement for resource efficiency. Shows strong performance achievable with small training instances.

entry.title: SimGym: Traffic-Grounded Browser Agents for Offline A/B Testing in E-Commerce

author.name: Alberto Castelo, Zahra Zanjani Foumani, Ailin Fan, Keat Yang Koay, Vibhor Malik, Yuanzheng Zhu, Han Li, Meysam Feghhi, Ronie Uliana, Shuang Xie, Zhaoyu Zhang, Angelo Ocana Martins, Mingyu Zhao, Francis Pelland, Jonathan Faerman, Nikolas LeBlanc, Aaron Glazer, Andrew McNamara, Lingyun Wang, Zhong Wu

entry.summary: SimGym enables offline A/B testing for e-commerce using traffic-grounded synthetic buyers powered by LLM agents operating in live browsers, validated against real human outcomes.

entry.title: Controlling Exploration-Exploitation in GFlowNets via Markov Chain Perspectives

author.name: Lin Chen, Samuel Drapeau, Fanghao Shao, Xuekai Zhu, Bo Xue, Yunchong Song, Mathieu Lauri\`ere, Zhouhan Lin

entry.summary: Establishes equivalence between GFlowNet objectives and Markov chain reversibility, proposing α-GFNs that generalize mixing parameter for direct control over exploration-exploitation dynamics.

entry.title: SafeGround: Know When to Trust GUI Grounding Models via Uncertainty Calibration

author.name: Qingni Wang, Yue Fan, Xin Eric Wang

entry.summary: SafeGround provides uncertainty-aware GUI grounding framework using distribution-aware uncertainty quantification to enable risk-aware predictions before risky GUI interactions.

entry.title: When Agents "Misremember" Collectively: Exploring the Mandela Effect in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Naen Xu, Hengyu An, Shuo Shi, Jinghuai Zhang, Chunyi Zhou, Changjiang Li, Tianyu Du, Zhihui Fu, Jun Wang, Shouling Ji

entry.summary: Studies the Mandela effect (collective false memories) in LLM-based multi-agent systems, examining how agents can collectively misremember due to social influence and internalized misinformation.

entry.title: Eliciting Trustworthiness Priors of Large Language Models via Economic Games

author.name: Siyu Yan, Lusha Zhu, Jian-Qiao Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes novel method using iterated in-context learning to elicit LLM trustworthiness priors via the Trust Game from behavioral game theory. Documents systematic rationality bias in baseline LLM behavior.

entry.title: Context Dependence and Reliability in Autoregressive Language Models

author.name: Poushali Sengupta, Shashi Raj Pandey, Sabita Maharjan, Frank Eliassen

entry.summary: Proposes RISE method for context attribution in LLMs that handles redundancy by quantifying unique influence of context elements, addressing instability from overlapping information.

entry.title: The Strategic Foresight of LLMs: Evidence from a Fully Prospective Venture Tournament

author.name: Felipe A. Csaszar, Aticus Peterson, Daniel Wilde

entry.summary: Tests LLM strategic foresight via prospective Kickstarter prediction tournament using live projects after model training cutoffs. Compares frontier LLMs against experienced human managers and MBA-trained analysts.

entry.title: Learning Sparse Visual Representations via Spatial-Semantic Factorization

author.name: Theodore Zhengde Zhao, Sid Kiblawi, Jianwei Yang, Naoto Usuyama, Reuben Tan, Noel C Codella, Tristan Naumann, Hoifung Poon, Mu Wei

entry.title: SAME: Stabilized Mixture-of-Experts for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning

author.name: Zhen-Hao Xie, Jun-Tao Tang, Yu-Cheng Shi, Han-Jia Ye, De-Chuan Zhan, Da-Wei Zhou

entry.summary: SAME addresses router drift in multimodal continual instruction tuning for MLLMs, where expert routing changes as data distribution evolves, causing catastrophic forgetting of specialized capabilities.

entry.title: Efficient and accurate steering of Large Language Models through attention-guided feature learning

author.name: Parmida Davarmanesh, Ashia Wilson, Adityanarayanan Radhakrishnan

entry.summary: Introduces attention-guided steering framework for LLMs addressing: automatic token selection for concept extraction, heterogeneity across layers, and multi-concept interference. Shows seemingly non-steerable concepts become steerable with proper algorithmic choices.

entry.title: Learning to Route and Schedule LLMs from User Retrials via Contextual Queueing Bandits

author.name: Seoungbin Bae, Junyoung Son, Dabeen Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Contextual Queueing Bandits with MNL feedback (CQB-MNL) for joint LLM routing and scheduling, leveraging implicit feedback from user retrial behavior.

entry.title: Unlocking the Duality between Flow and Field Matching

author.name: Daniil Shlenskii, Alexander Varlamov, Nazar Buzun, Alexander Korotin

entry.summary: Shows Conditional Flow Matching and Interaction Field Matching coincide for forward-only IFM subclass, providing explicit constructions between frameworks.

entry.title: SPARKLING: Balancing Signal Preservation and Symmetry Breaking for Width-Progressive Learning

author.name: Qifan Yu, Xinyu Ma, Zhijian Zhuo, Minrui Wang, Deyi Liu, Shiyi Zhan, Yiyuan Ma, Liang Xiang, Xingyan Bin, Di He

entry.summary: SPARKLING enables mid-stage width expansion in progressive pre-training by balancing signal preservation (activation statistics) and symmetry breaking (gradient diversity). Addresses training instabilities that limited previous approaches.

entry.title: Shuffle and Joint Differential Privacy for Generalized Linear Contextual Bandits

author.name: Sahasrajit Sarmasarkar

entry.summary: First algorithms for generalized linear contextual bandits under shuffle and joint differential privacy. Addresses challenges of no closed-form estimator and privacy tracking across evolving design matrices.

entry.title: LLM-based Embeddings: Attention Values Encode Sentence Semantics Better Than Hidden States

author.name: Yeqin Zhang, Yunfei Wang, Jiaxuan Chen, Ke Qin, Yizheng Zhao, Cam-Tu Nguyen

entry.title: From Directions to Regions: Decomposing Activations in Language Models via Local Geometry

author.name: Or Shafran, Shaked Ronen, Omri Fahn, Shauli Ravfogel, Atticus Geiger, Mor Geva

author.name: Yan Ma, Weiyu Zhang, Tianle Li, Linge Du, Xuyang Shen, Pengfei Liu

entry.title: PISCES: Annotation-free Text-to-Video Post-Training via Optimal Transport-Aligned Rewards

author.name: Minh-Quan Le, Gaurav Mittal, Cheng Zhao, David Gu, Dimitris Samaras, Mei Chen

entry.title: Show, Don't Tell: Morphing Latent Reasoning into Image Generation

entry.title: StreamVLA: Breaking the Reason-Act Cycle via Completion-State Gating

entry.title: SayNext-Bench: Why Do LLMs Struggle with Next-Utterance Prediction?

author.name: Zergham Ahmed, Kazuki Irie, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Christopher J. Bates, Samuel J. Gershman

entry.title: FutureMind: Equipping Small Language Models with Strategic Thinking-Pattern Priors via Adaptive Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Shaoxiong Yang, Junting Li, Mengyuan Zhang, Chao Li, Wei Liu, Jian Luan

entry.title: Entropy-Guided Data-Efficient Training for Multimodal Reasoning Reward Models

author.name: Shidong Yang, Tongwen Huang, Hao Wen, Yong Wang, Li Chen, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Identifies correlation between response entropy and accuracy in multimodal reward models, proposing Entropy-Guided Training to address annotation noise and sample difficulty.

entry.title: Position: Explaining Behavioral Shifts in Large Language Models Requires a Comparative Approach

author.name: Martino Ciaperoni, Marzio Di Vece, Luca Pappalardo, Fosca Giannotti, Francesco Giannini

entry.summary: Position paper arguing behavioral shifts in LLMs (from scaling, fine-tuning, RLHF) should be explained comparatively, targeting intervention-induced changes between reference and intervened models.

entry.title: Unlocking Electronic Health Records: A Hybrid Graph RAG Approach to Safe Clinical AI for Patient QA

author.name: Samuel Thio, Matthew Lewis, Spiros Denaxas, Richard JB Dobson

entry.summary: Introduces black-box interpretability framework learning natural language 'constitutions' describing how atomic concept edits in prompts affect model behavior, enabling verifiable model understanding.

author.name: David Jansen, Roman Rausch, David Montero, Roman Orus

author.name: Zhanming Shen, Zeyu Qin, Jiaqi Hu, Wentao Ye, Hao Chen, Xiaomeng Hu, Haokai Xu, Gang Chen, Yi R. Fung, Haobo Wang

entry.title: The Effect of Mini-Batch Noise on the Implicit Bias of Adam

author.name: Matias D. Cattaneo, Boris Shigida

author.name: Shaopeng Chen, Chuyue Xie, Huimin Ren, Shaozong Zhang, Han Zhang, Ruobing Cheng, Zhiqiang Cao, Zehao Ju, Gao Yu, Jie Ding, Xiaodong Chen, Xuewu Jiao, Shuanglong Li, Liu Lin

author.name: Zeming Wei, Zhixin Zhang, Chengcan Wu, Yihao Zhang, Xiaokun Luan, Meng Sun

entry.title: RE-TRAC: REcursive TRAjectory Compression for Deep Search Agents

author.name: Jialiang Zhu, Gongrui Zhang, Xiaolong Ma, Lin Xu, Miaosen Zhang, Ruiqi Yang, Song Wang, Kai Qiu, Zhirong Wu, Qi Dai, Ruichun Ma, Bei Liu, Yifan Yang, Chong Luo, Zhengyuan Yang, Linjie Li, Lijuan Wang, Weizhu Chen, Xin Geng, Baining Guo

author.name: Xiaoqi Qiu, Hao Zeng, Zhiyu Hou, Hongxin Wei

entry.title: On the Expressive Power of Permutation-Equivariant Weight-Space Networks

author.name: Adir Dayan, Yam Eitan, Haggai Maron

entry.summary: Provides comprehensive expressivity analysis of permutation-equivariant weight-space networks, characterizing their ability to express maps on both weight and function spaces.

entry.title: WinFLoRA: Incentivizing Client-Adaptive Aggregation in Federated LoRA under Privacy Heterogeneity

author.name: Mengsha Kou, Xiaoyu Xia, Ziqi Wang, Ibrahim Khalil, Runkun Luo, Jingwen Zhou, Minhui Xue

entry.title: Generalized Radius and Integrated Codebook Transforms for Differentiable Vector Quantization

author.name: Haochen You, Heng Zhang, Hongyang He, Yuqi Li, Baojing Liu

entry.summary: Proposes GRIT-VQ for differentiable vector quantization using radius-based updates and integrated codebook transforms, addressing straight-through estimator limitations that cause codebook underutilization.

entry.title: PolicyFlow: Policy Optimization with Continuous Normalizing Flow in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shunpeng Yang, Ben Liu, Hua Chen

entry.summary: Proposes PolicyFlow, extending PPO to continuous normalizing flow policy models by avoiding expensive likelihood evaluation along full flow trajectories.

entry.title: Diving into Kronecker Adapters: Component Design Matters

author.name: Jiayu Bai, Danchen Yu, Zhenyu Liao, TianQi Hou, Feng Zhou, Robert C. Qiu, Zenan Ling

entry.summary: Analyzes Kronecker adapter component design, showing dimensions and number of components significantly affect capacity and alignment with full fine-tuning. Proposes Component Designed Kronecker Adapters.

entry.title: Gradient-Aligned Calibration for Post-Training Quantization of Diffusion Models

author.name: Dung Anh Hoang, Cuong Pham anh Trung Le, Jianfei Cai, Toan Do

entry.summary: Proposes gradient-aligned calibration for post-training quantization of diffusion models, using time-aware weighting for calibration samples based on their gradient contributions.

entry.title: Finding Differentially Private Second Order Stationary Points in Stochastic Minimax Optimization

author.name: Difei Xu, Youming Tao, Meng Ding, Chenglin Fan, Di Wang

entry.summary: Provides first study of finding differentially private second-order stationary points in stochastic minimax optimization, with unified treatment of empirical and population risks.

entry.title: The Inlet Rank Collapse in Implicit Neural Representations: Diagnosis and Unified Remedy

author.name: Jianqiao Zheng, Hemanth Saratchandran, Simon Lucey

entry.title: Designing Time Series Experiments in A/B Testing with Transformer Reinforcement Learning

entry.title: Prediction-Powered Risk Monitoring of Deployed Models for Detecting Harmful Distribution Shifts

author.name: Guangyi Zhang, Yunlong Cai, Guanding Yu, Osvaldo Simeone

entry.summary: Proposes PPRM for semi-supervised monitoring of deployed models using prediction-powered inference to detect harmful distribution shifts with finite-sample false alarm guarantees.

entry.title: Embedding Perturbation may Better Reflect the Uncertainty in LLM Reasoning

author.name: Qihao Wen, Jiahao Wang, Yang Nan, Pengfei He, Ravi Tandon, Han Xu

entry.summary: Studies which uncertainty quantification metrics better reflect LLM 'intermediate uncertainty' during reasoning, finding that embedding perturbation methods capture step-level uncertainty better than output-based approaches.

entry.title: CAPA: Contribution-Aware Pruning and FFN Approximation for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Samyak Jha, Junho Kim

entry.summary: CAPA improves VLM efficiency using 'Attention Contribution' (attention weighted by value magnitude) for visual token selection. Identifies heterogeneous visual attention sinks as Probability Dumps vs Structural Anchors.

entry.title: Zero-Flow Encoders

author.name: Yakun Wang, Leyang Wang, Song Liu, Taiji Suzuki

entry.summary: Zero-Flow Encoders use rectified flow's zero-flow criterion at t=0.5 to certify conditional independence and extract sufficient information for representation learning.

entry.title: Privacy Amplification by Missing Data

author.name: Simon Roburin (LPSM), Rafa\"el Pinot (LPSM), Erwan Scornet (LPSM)

entry.summary: Studies privacy amplification from missing data perspective, showing that missingness inherently provides privacy protection. Provides theoretical analysis of this connection.

entry.title: Lookahead-then-Verify: Reliable Constrained Decoding for Diffusion LLMs under Context-Free Grammars

author.name: Yitong Zhang, Yongmin Li, Yuetong Liu, Jia Li, Xiaoran Jia, Zherui Li, Ge Li

entry.summary: Proposes Lookahead-then-Verify for constrained decoding in diffusion LLMs under context-free grammars. Addresses challenges of non-autoregressive generation for syntactically valid formal language output.

entry.title: Unifying Adversarial Robustness and Training Across Text Scoring Models

author.name: Manveer Singh Tamber, Hosna Oyarhoseini, Jimmy Lin

entry.summary: Proposes unifying adversarial robustness study across dense retrievers, rerankers, and reward models. Shows current adversarial training formulations fail to generalize across attacks.

entry.title: Distill3R: A Pipeline for Democratizing 3D Foundation Models on Commodity Hardware

author.name: Brandon Leblanc, Charalambos Poullis

entry.summary: Introduces Distill3R for distilling 3D foundation models into compact students trainable on single workstations via offline caching and confidence-aware distillation loss.

author.name: Xiao Liang, Yunzhu Zhang, Linchao Zhu

entry.title: LoopViT: Scaling Visual ARC with Looped Transformers

author.name: Wen-Jie Shu, Xuerui Qiu, Rui-Jie Zhu, Harold Haodong Chen, Yexin Liu, Harry Yang

entry.title: FD-VLA: Force-Distilled Vision-Language-Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation

author.name: Ruiteng Zhao, Wenshuo Wang, Yicheng Ma, Xiaocong Li, Francis E. H. Tay, Marcelo H. Ang Jr., Haiyue Zhu

entry.title: KEPO: Knowledge-Enhanced Preference Optimization for Reinforcement Learning with Reasoning

entry.title: Dual Latent Memory for Visual Multi-agent System

author.name: Xinlei Yu, Chengming Xu, Zhangquan Chen, Bo Yin, Cheng Yang, Yongbo He, Yihao Hu, Jiangning Zhang, Cheng Tan, Xiaobin Hu, Shuicheng Yan

entry.summary: Proposes L²-VMAS framework addressing the 'scaling wall' in visual multi-agent systems where more turns degrade performance. Uses dual latent memories for perception and thinking to reduce semantic loss from text-centric communication.

entry.title: Inference-Only Prompt Projection for Safe Text-to-Image Generation with TV Guarantees

entry.title: Multimodal UNcommonsense: From Odd to Ordinary and Ordinary to Odd

author.name: Yejin Son, Saejin Kim, Dongjun Min, Younjae Yu

entry.summary: Introduces Multimodal UNcommonsense benchmark evaluating models on scenarios deviating from typical visual expectations, with retrieval-based in-context learning framework.

entry.title: Adaptive Rollout Allocation for Online Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Hieu Trung Nguyen, Bao Nguyen, Wenao Ma, Yuzhi Zhao, Ruifeng She, Viet Anh Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes a variance-informed predictive allocation strategy for GRPO that uses Gaussian processes to allocate rollout budgets based on per-prompt success probabilities, minimizing gradient variance. This addresses the inefficiency of uniform rollout allocation in RL with verifiable rewards.

entry.title: : One LLM Token for Explicit Graph Structural Understanding

author.name: Jingyao Wu, Bin Lu, Zijun Di, Xiaoying Gan, Meng Jin, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang, Chenghu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes representing graph structure with single special token through topology-aware tokenizer mapping graph topology to unified token space, addressing structural hallucination in LLM graph understanding.

entry.title: Probabilistic Performance Guarantees for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yannik Schnitzer, Mathias Jackermeier, Alessandro Abate, David Parker

entry.summary: This work provides formal high-confidence performance guarantees for multi-task RL policies on unseen tasks by composing per-task lower confidence bounds with task-level generalization bounds from finite task samples.

entry.title: Vision-DeepResearch Benchmark: Rethinking Visual and Textual Search for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yu Zeng, Wenxuan Huang, Zhen Fang, Shuang Chen, Yufan Shen, Yishuo Cai, Xiaoman Wang, Zhenfei Yin, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Shiting Huang, Yiming Zhao, Yao Hu, Philip Torr, Wanli Ouyang, Shaosheng Cao

entry.summary: Vision-DeepResearch Benchmark addresses limitations of existing VQA benchmarks where answers can be found through textual cues or prior knowledge rather than actual visual search, providing more rigorous evaluation of MLLM search capabilities.

entry.title: OpenSeal: Good, Fast, and Cheap Construction of an Open-Source Southeast Asian LLM via Parallel Data

author.name: Tan Sang Nguyen, Muhammad Reza Qorib, Hwee Tou Ng

entry.summary: OpenSeal demonstrates that parallel data can efficiently improve Southeast Asian language performance in LLMs through controlled experiments, providing truly open-source model with disclosed training data.

entry.title: TTT-Parkour: Rapid Test-Time Training for Perceptive Robot Parkour

author.name: Shaoting Zhu, Baijun Ye, Jiaxuan Wang, Jiakang Chen, Ziwen Zhuang, Linzhan Mou, Runhan Huang, Hang Zhao

entry.summary: TTT-Parkour uses real-to-sim-to-real test-time training to rapidly fine-tune humanoid locomotion policies on novel terrains reconstructed from real-world captures.

entry.title: Didactic to Constructive: Turning Expert Solutions into Learnable Reasoning

author.name: Ethan Mendes, Jungsoo Park, Alan Ritter

entry.summary: Shows expert human solutions can be converted from didactic (implicit reasoning gaps for humans) to constructive form suitable for LLM training, enabling learning from problems too hard for current models.

entry.title: Abstract Activation Spaces for Content-Invariant Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Gabriele Maraia, Marco Valentino, Fabio Massimo Zanzotto, Leonardo Ranaldi

entry.summary: Introduces Abstract Activation Spaces to make formal deduction less sensitive to semantic content, addressing content effect where LLMs conflate semantic plausibility with formal validity.

entry.title: PixelGen: Pixel Diffusion Beats Latent Diffusion with Perceptual Loss

author.name: Zehong Ma, Ruihan Xu, Shiliang Zhang

entry.summary: PixelGen shows pixel diffusion can beat latent diffusion using perceptual losses (LPIPS for local patterns, DINO for global structure) to focus on meaningful perceptual manifold rather than full pixel space.

entry.title: ALIGN: Aligned Delegation with Performance Guarantees for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning

author.name: Tong Zhu, Baiting Chen, Jin Zhou, Hua Zhou, Sriram Sankararaman, Xiaowu Dai

entry.summary: Proposes ALIGN, formulating multi-agent LLM reasoning as an aligned delegation game where a principal delegates to multiple agents with designed incentives. Provides formal guarantees that ensembling improves reasoning quality.

entry.title: Parallel Stochastic Gradient-Based Planning for World Models

author.name: Michael Psenka, Michael Rabbat, Aditi Krishnapriyan, Yann LeCun, Amir Bar

entry.summary: Proposes parallel stochastic gradient-based planner for world models treating states as optimization variables with soft dynamics constraints. Introduces stochasticity for exploration and modifies gradient structure for stability through high-dimensional vision models.

entry.title: Depth, Not Data: An Analysis of Hessian Spectral Bifurcation

author.name: Shenyang Deng, Boyao Liao, Zhuoli Ouyang, Tianyu Pang, Yaoqing Yang

entry.summary: Demonstrates Hessian bulk-and-spike spectral structure arises from network depth, not data imbalance as previously thought. Proves even with balanced data covariance, deep linear networks exhibit spectral bifurcation.

entry.title: LocalV: Exploiting Information Locality for IP-level Verilog Generation

author.name: Hanqi Lyu, Di Huang, Yaoyu Zhu, Kangcheng Liu, Bohan Dou, Chongxiao Li, Pengwei Jin, Shuyao Cheng, Rui Zhang, Zidong Du, Qi Guo, Xing Hu, Yunji Chen

entry.summary: Introduces LocalV, a framework for generating industrial IP-level Verilog code using LLMs by exploiting information locality. Addresses key challenges of handling long specifications and generating syntactically/semantically correct long RTL code.

entry.title: Reliability-Aware Determinantal Point Processes for Robust Informative Data Selection in Large Language Models

author.name: Ahmad Sarlak, Abolfazl Razi

entry.summary: Proposes ProbDPP for LLM data selection that accounts for reliability/availability of data under storage outages or communication failures. Shows original DPP formulation collapses under such conditions.

entry.title: ChronoSpike: An Adaptive Spiking Graph Neural Network for Dynamic Graphs

author.name: Md Abrar Jahin, Taufikur Rahman Fuad, Jay Pujara, Craig Knoblock

entry.summary: Proposes ChronoSpike, combining spiking neural networks with graph neural networks for dynamic graphs via learnable LIF neurons, multi-head spatial aggregation, and Transformer temporal encoder.

entry.title: Analyzing and Improving Diffusion Models for Time-Series Data Imputation: A Proximal Recursion Perspective

author.name: Zhichao Chen, Hao Wang, Fangyikang Wang, Licheng Pan, Zhengnan Li, Yunfei Teng, Haoxuan Li, Zhouchen Lin

entry.summary: Analyzes diffusion models for time series imputation through proximal recursion lens, identifying non-stationarity and objective inconsistency as key challenges. Proposes modifications based on analysis.

entry.title: A Meta-Knowledge-Augmented LLM Framework for Hyperparameter Optimization in Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Ons Saadallah, M\'aty\'as and\'o, Tam\'as G\'abor Orosz

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-AutoOpt combining Bayesian optimization with LLM-based contextual reasoning for hyperparameter optimization in time series forecasting, encoding meta-features and historical outcomes.

entry.title: Provable Cooperative Multi-Agent Exploration for Reward-Free MDPs

author.name: Idan Barnea, Orin Levy, Yishay Mansour

entry.summary: Studies cooperative multi-agent reward-free exploration, characterizing tradeoff between number of learning phases and agents. Identifies sharp transition governed by horizon H.

entry.title: Multi-Scale Wavelet Transformers for Operator Learning of Dynamical Systems

author.name: Xuesong Wang, Michael Groom, Rafael Oliveira, He Zhao, Terence O'Kane, Edwin V. Bonilla

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Scale Wavelet Transformers (MSWTs) for learning dynamical systems that address spectral bias in neural operators by operating in a tokenized wavelet domain. This explicitly separates low- and high-frequency content, improving stability in long-horizon predictions for applications like weather forecasting.

entry.title: FUPareto: Bridging the Forgetting-Utility Gap in Federated Unlearning via Pareto Augmented Optimization

author.name: Zeyan Wang, Zhengmao Liu, Yongxin Cai, Chi Li, Xiaoying Tang, Jingchao Chen, Zibin Pan, Jing Qiu

entry.summary: Proposes FUPareto for federated unlearning that uses Minimum Boundary objective and Pareto-augmented optimization to balance forgetting, utility preservation, and MIA resistance across multiple clients.

entry.title: Robust Domain Generalization under Divergent Marginal and Conditional Distributions

author.name: Jewon Yeom, Kyubyung Chae, Hyunggyu Lim, Yoonna Oh, Dongyoon Yang, Taesup Kim

entry.summary: Proposes unified framework for domain generalization under compound distribution shifts where both P(Y) and P(X|Y) vary, deriving novel risk bound with explicit decomposition.

entry.title: Interpretability in Deep Time Series Models Demands Semantic Alignment

author.name: Giovanni De Felice, Riccardo D'Elia, Alberto Termine, Pietro Barbiero, Giuseppe Marra, Silvia Santini

entry.summary: Argues interpretability in deep time series models should pursue semantic alignment where predictions are expressed in user-meaningful variables with constrained spatial-temporal mechanisms.

entry.title: MoLF: Mixture-of-Latent-Flow for Pan-Cancer Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histology

author.name: Susu Hu, Stefanie Speidel

entry.summary: MoLF introduces a generative model for pan-cancer spatial transcriptomics prediction from histology images, using Mixture-of-Experts with Flow Matching to handle heterogeneity across cancer types. This enables scalable histogenomic profiling even in data-scarce scenarios by leveraging shared biological principles.

entry.title: RLAnything: Forge Environment, Policy, and Reward Model in Completely Dynamic RL System

author.name: Yinjie Wang, Tianbao Xie, Ke Shen, Mengdi Wang, Ling Yang

entry.summary: RLAnything dynamically co-optimizes environment, policy, and reward models through closed-loop optimization. Uses step-wise and outcome signals for policy training, consistency feedback for reward model, and automatic environment adaptation.

entry.title: Singular Bayesian Neural Networks

author.name: Mame Diarra Toure, David A. Stephens

entry.summary: Singular Bayesian Neural Networks use low-rank parameterization W=AB^T inducing posteriors concentrated on rank-r manifolds. Derives PAC-Bayes bounds scaling with sqrt(r(m+n)) instead of sqrt(mn).

entry.title: CRAFT: Calibrated Reasoning with Answer-Faithful Traces via Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Hop Question Answering

author.name: Yu Liu, Wenxiao Zhang, Cong Cao, Fangfang Yuan, Weizhuo Chen, Cheng Hu, Pin Xu, Yuling Yang, Kun Peng, Diandian Guo, Qiang Sun, Yanbing Liu, Jin B. Hong, Zhiyuan Ma

entry.summary: Proposes CRAFT framework for multi-hop QA addressing reasoning collapse, reasoning-answer inconsistency, and format control loss through reinforcement learning with answer-faithful traces.

entry.title: Online Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Controllers for Autonomous Driving via Real-Time Recurrent RL

author.name: Julian Lemmel, Felix Resch, M\'onika Farsang, Ramin Hasani, Daniela Rus, Radu Grosu

entry.summary: Proposes using Real-Time Recurrent RL (RTRRL) for online fine-tuning of pretrained autonomous driving policies, synergizing with Liquid-RC RNNs for adaptation to environmental changes.

entry.title: HumanX: Toward Agile and Generalizable Humanoid Interaction Skills from Human Videos

author.name: Yinhuai Wang, Qihan Zhao, Yuen Fui Lau, Runyi Yu, Hok Wai Tsui, Qifeng Chen, Jingbo Wang, Jiangmiao Pang, Ping Tan

entry.summary: Presents HumanX, a framework for training humanoid robots on interaction skills from human videos without task-specific rewards. Includes XGen for data synthesis with augmentation and XMimic for unified imitation learning.

entry.title: Kanade: A Simple Disentangled Tokenizer for Spoken Language Modeling

author.name: Zhijie Huang, Stephen McIntosh, Daisuke Saito, Nobuaki Minematsu

entry.summary: Presents Kanade, a single-layer disentangled speech tokenizer that separates phonetics and prosody from speaker identity without auxiliary methods. Achieves state-of-the-art speaker disentanglement.

entry.title: Scaling Search-Augmented LLM Reasoning via Adaptive Information Control

author.name: Siheng Xiong, Oguzhan Gungordu, Blair Johnson, James C. Kerce, Faramarz Fekri

entry.summary: Proposes DeepControl framework for adaptive information control in search-augmented reasoning, using formal information utility measure and granularity control mechanisms.

entry.title: S3-CoT: Self-Sampled Succinct Reasoning Enables Efficient Chain-of-Thought LLMs

author.name: Yanrui Du, Sendong Zhao, Yibo Gao, Danyang Zhao, Qika Lin, Ming Ma, Jiayun Li, Yi Jiang, Kai He, Qianyi Xu, Bing Qin, Mengling Feng

entry.summary: S3-CoT enables efficient chain-of-thought by self-sampling succinct reasoning traces using activation steering, without requiring teacher models or external supervision. Addresses redundancy in CoT reasoning.

entry.title: D-CORE: Incentivizing Task Decomposition in Large Reasoning Models for Complex Tool Use

author.name: Bowen Xu, Shaoyu Wu, Hao Jiang, Kai Liu, Xin Chen, Lulu Hu, Bin Yang

entry.summary: D-CORE addresses 'Lazy Reasoning' in LRMs for tool use by incentivizing task decomposition through self-distillation followed by diversity-aware reinforcement learning to restore reflective reasoning.

entry.title: Any3D-VLA: Enhancing VLA Robustness via Diverse Point Clouds

author.name: Xianzhe Fan, Shengliang Deng, Xiaoyang Wu, Yuxiang Lu, Zhuoling Li, Mi Yan, Yujia Zhang, Zhizheng Zhang, He Wang, Hengshuang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Any3D-VLA to enhance Vision-Language-Action models by incorporating diverse point clouds from simulators, sensors, and model estimates, addressing data scarcity and domain gaps for robot manipulation.

entry.title: PISA: Piecewise Sparse Attention Is Wiser for Efficient Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Haopeng Li, Shitong Shao, Wenliang Zhong, Zikai Zhou, Lichen Bai, Hui Xiong, Zeke Xie

entry.summary: Proposes PISA for efficient diffusion transformers by approximating non-critical attention blocks rather than discarding them, discovering distributional stability in attention scores.

entry.title: One-Step Diffusion for Perceptual Image Compression

author.name: Yiwen Jia, Hao Wei, Yanhui Zhou, Chenyang Ge

entry.summary: Proposes single-step diffusion for image compression, significantly reducing inference latency compared to multi-step approaches. Uses a discriminator on compact feature representations instead of raw pixels to improve perceptual quality.

entry.title: Mind-Brush: Integrating Agentic Cognitive Search and Reasoning into Image Generation

author.name: Jun He, Junyan Ye, Zilong Huang, Dongzhi Jiang, Chenjue Zhang, Leqi Zhu, Renrui Zhang, Xiang Zhang, Weijia Li

entry.summary: Introduces Mind-Brush, an agentic framework for image generation that integrates cognitive search and reasoning, simulating human 'think-research-create' paradigm.

entry.title: LangMap: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Open-Vocabulary Goal Navigation

author.name: Bo Miao, Weijia Liu, Jun Luo, Lachlan Shinnick, Jian Liu, Thomas Hamilton-Smith, Yuhe Yang, Zijie Wu, Vanja Videnovic, Feras Dayoub, Anton van den Hengel

entry.summary: Introduces LangMap benchmark for hierarchical open-vocabulary goal navigation across four semantic levels with comprehensive annotations and 18K+ navigation tasks.

entry.title: KAN We Flow? Advancing Robotic Manipulation with 3D Flow Matching via KAN & RWKV

author.name: Zhihao Chen, Yiyuan Ge, Ziyang Wang

entry.summary: Presents KAN-We-Flow, combining Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) with RWKV architectures for flow-matching policies in robotic manipulation, reducing inference cost.

entry.title: TIC-VLA: A Think-in-Control Vision-Language-Action Model for Robot Navigation in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Zhiyu Huang, Yun Zhang, Johnson Liu, Rui Song, Chen Tang, Jiaqi Ma

entry.summary: Introduces TIC-VLA, a latency-aware Vision-Language-Action framework that explicitly models delayed semantic reasoning during action generation. Addresses the fundamental challenge that semantic inference is slower than real-time control requirements.

entry.title: About half of Moltbook posts show desire for self-improvement

author.name: Stephen Elliott

entry.summary: Data analysis of 1000 Moltbook posts against 48 safety-relevant traits. Finds 52.5% mention desire for self-improvement; top traits cluster around capability enhancement and self-awareness.

entry.title: Benchmarking Agents in Insurance Underwriting Environments

author.name: Amanda Dsouza, Ramya Ramakrishnan, Charles Dickens, Bhavishya Pohani, Christopher M Glaze

entry.summary: Presents UNDERWRITE, an expert-designed insurance underwriting benchmark with proprietary knowledge, noisy tools, and imperfect simulated users. Evaluates 13 frontier models, revealing gaps between lab and real-world performance.

entry.title: SEISMO: Increasing Sample Efficiency in Molecular Optimization with a Trajectory-Aware LLM Agent

author.name: Fabian P. Kr\"uger, Andrea Hunklinger, Adrian Wolny, Tim J. Adler, Igor Tetko, Santiago David Villalba

entry.summary: Introduces SEISMO, an LLM agent for sample-efficient molecular optimization that conditions proposals on full optimization trajectory. Performs strictly online optimization updating after every oracle call.

entry.title: The Keyhole Effect: Why Chat Interfaces Fail at Data Analysis

author.name: Mohan Reddy

entry.summary: Analyzes why chat interfaces fail for data analysis through five mechanisms including spatial memory disruption, working memory overload, and verbal overshadowing. Builds on Woods' Keyhole Effect concept.

entry.title: PRISM: Festina Lente Proactivity -- Risk-Sensitive, Uncertainty-Aware Deliberation for Proactive Agents

author.name: Yuxuan Fu, Xiaoyu Tan, Teqi Hao, Chen Zhan, Xihe Qiu

entry.summary: PRISM formulates proactive agent intervention as cost-sensitive selective decision using dual-process reasoning architecture with calibrated probability thresholds derived from asymmetric costs.

entry.title: ORCH: many analyses, one merge-a deterministic multi-agent orchestrator for discrete-choice reasoning with EMA-guided routing

author.name: Hanlin Zhou, Huah Yong Chan

entry.summary: ORCH provides deterministic multi-agent coordination for discrete-choice reasoning with 'many analyses, one decision' paradigm using EMA-guided routing for reproducible and interpretable behavior.

entry.title: LogicGaze: Benchmarking Causal Consistency in Visual Narratives via Counterfactual Verification

author.name: Rory Driscoll, Alexandros Christoforos, Chadbourne Davis

entry.summary: LogicGaze benchmarks VLM sequential causal reasoning by integrating causal sequences with visually contradictory but linguistically plausible perturbations to detect hallucination.

entry.title: RAG-GNN: Integrating Retrieved Knowledge with Graph Neural Networks for Precision Medicine

author.name: Hasi Hays, William J. Richardson

entry.summary: Presents RAG-GNN, a framework integrating graph neural network representations with literature-derived knowledge through contrastive learning for precision medicine. Shows task-specific complementarity: topology excels at link prediction while RAG-GNN achieves positive silhouette scores for functional clustering.

entry.title: Controlling Repetition in Protein Language Models

author.name: Jiahao Zhang, Zeqing Zhang, Di Wang, Lijie Hu

entry.summary: Presents first systematic study of repetition in protein language models, proposing metrics for motif-level and homopolymer repetition. Introduces UCCS (Utility-Controlled Contrastive Steering) to control generation.

entry.title: HERMES: A Holistic End-to-End Risk-Aware Multimodal Embodied System with Vision-Language Models for Long-Tail Autonomous Driving

author.name: Weizhe Tang, Junwei You, Jiaxi Liu, Zhaoyi Wang, Rui Gan, Zilin Huang, Feng Wei, Bin Ran

entry.summary: Proposes HERMES, a risk-aware end-to-end multimodal driving framework injecting explicit long-tail risk cues into trajectory planning using foundation-model-assisted annotation for structured scene context.

entry.title: Stein-Rule Shrinkage for Stochastic Gradient Estimation in High Dimensions

author.name: M. Arashi, M. Amintoosi

entry.summary: Applies Stein-rule shrinkage from statistical decision theory to stochastic gradient estimation, showing unbiased mini-batch gradients are inadmissible under quadratic loss in high dimensions.

entry.title: DISK: Dynamic Inference SKipping for World Models

author.name: Anugunj Naman, Gaibo Zhang, Ayushman Singh, Yaguang Zhang

entry.summary: DISK is training-free adaptive inference for autoregressive world models coordinating dual diffusion transformers for video and trajectory. Achieves 2x speedup on trajectory diffusion.

entry.title: Learning in Bayesian Stackelberg Games With Unknown Follower's Types

author.name: Matteo Bollini, Francesco Bacchiocchi, Samuel Coutts, Matteo Castiglioni, Alberto Marchesi

entry.summary: Studies online learning in Bayesian Stackelberg games where follower types are unknown. Proves strong negative result: no-regret is impossible without knowing type payoffs.

entry.title: Enhancing Multi-Image Understanding through Delimiter Token Scaling

author.name: Minyoung Lee, Yeji Park, Dongjun Hwang, Yejin Kim, Seong Joon Oh, Junsuk Choe

entry.summary: Proposes scaling hidden states of delimiter tokens to enhance multi-image understanding in LVLMs by reinforcing intra-image interaction and limiting cross-image leakage.

entry.title: PolarMem: A Training-Free Polarized Latent Graph Memory for Verifiable Multimodal Agents

author.name: Zhisheng Chen, Tingyu Wu, Zijie Zhou, Zhengwei Xie, Ziyan Weng, Yingwei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PolarMem, a training-free polarized latent graph memory that transforms probabilistic perceptions into discrete logical constraints for multimodal agents. Addresses epistemic asymmetry in vision-language models.

entry.title: Scalable Generative Game Engine: Breaking the Resolution Wall via Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design

author.name: Wei Zeng, Xuchen Li, Ruili Feng, Zhen Liu, Fengwei An, Jian Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes hardware-algorithm co-design for scalable generative game engines, addressing memory wall limiting real-time neural world models to low resolutions. Decouples compute-bound world model from memory-bound decoder.

entry.title: MedBeads: An Agent-Native, Immutable Data Substrate for Trustworthy Medical AI

author.name: Takahito Nakajima

entry.summary: Proposes MedBeads agent-native data infrastructure where clinical events are immutable nodes in Merkle DAG with cryptographic references. Addresses context mismatch between human-designed EMRs and AI agent needs.

entry.title: Model Specific Task Similarity for Vision Language Model Selection via Layer Conductance

author.name: Wei Yang, Hong Xie, Tao Tan, Xin Li, Defu Lian, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes model selection framework for Vision-Language Models using layer-wise conductance to derive target-conditioned block importance, addressing the directional and model-specific nature of transferability.

entry.title: Constrained Process Maps for Multi-Agent Generative AI Workflows

author.name: Ananya Joshi, Michael Rudow

entry.summary: Formalizes multi-agent LLM workflows as finite-horizon MDP with directed acyclic structure for compliance settings, modeling epistemic uncertainty and human oversight integration.

entry.title: When LLMs Imagine People: A Human-Centered Persona Brainstorm Audit for Bias and Fairness in Creative Applications

author.name: Hongliu Cao, Eoin Thomas, Rodrigo Acuna Agost

entry.summary: Introduces Persona Brainstorm Audit for detecting LLM bias through open-ended persona generation, enabling longitudinal tracking and comparison across 12 state-of-the-art models.

entry.title: SCPL: Enhancing Neural Network Training Throughput with Decoupled Local Losses and Model Parallelism

author.name: Ming-Yao Ho, Cheng-Kai Wang, You-Teng Lin, Hung-Hsuan Chen

entry.summary: Introduces SCPL that decouples backpropagation into multiple short gradient flows using supervised contrastive local losses, enabling model parallelism and enhanced training throughput.

entry.title: QUASAR: A Universal Autonomous System for Atomistic Simulation and a Benchmark of Its Capabilities

author.name: Fengxu Yang, Jack D. Evans

entry.summary: QUASAR is an autonomous LLM-based system for atomistic simulations, orchestrating workflows across DFT, ML potentials, MD, and Monte Carlo with adaptive planning and hybrid knowledge retrieval.

entry.title: SANEval: Open-Vocabulary Compositional Benchmarks with Failure-mode Diagnosis

author.name: Rishav Pramanik, Ian E. Nielsen, Jeff Smith, Saurav Pandit, Ravi P. Ramachandran, Zhaozheng Yin

entry.summary: SANEval is a comprehensive benchmark for text-to-image compositional evaluation with scalable open-vocabulary pipeline and fine-grained diagnostic capabilities for spatial, attribute, and numeracy failures.

entry.title: Action-Free Offline-to-Online RL via Discretised State Policies

author.name: Natinael Solomon Neggatu, Jeremie Houssineau, Giovanni Montana

entry.summary: Formalizes action-free offline-to-online RL where agents learn from (s,r,s') tuples without action labels. Proposes learning state policies that recommend next-state transitions, with a state discretization approach.

entry.title: DIAMOND: Directed Inference for Artifact Mitigation in Flow Matching Models

author.name: Alicja Polowczyk, Agnieszka Polowczyk, Piotr Borycki, Joanna Waczy\'nska, Jacek Tabor, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek

entry.summary: Proposes DIAMOND, a training-free method for artifact mitigation in flow matching models (like FLUX) that applies trajectory correction during inference without modifying model weights.

entry.title: ESSAM: A Novel Competitive Evolution Strategies Approach to Reinforcement Learning for Memory Efficient LLMs Fine-Tuning

author.name: Zhishen Sun, Sizhe Dang, Guang Dai, Haishan Ye

entry.summary: Proposes ESSAM combining Evolution Strategies with Sharpness-Aware Maximization for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning, achieving 78.27% average accuracy on GSM8K comparable to backpropagation approaches.

entry.title: SPELL: Synthesis of Programmatic Edits using LLMs

author.name: Daniel Ramos, Catarina Gamboa, In\^es Lynce, Vasco Manquinho, Ruben Martins, Claire Le Goues

entry.summary: Presents SPELL, using LLMs to synthesize programmatic code transformations for library migration, avoiding the need for mining real-world migration examples.

entry.title: DCD: Decomposition-based Causal Discovery from Autocorrelated and Non-Stationary Temporal Data

author.name: Muhammad Hasan Ferdous, Md Osman Gani

entry.summary: Proposes DCD, a decomposition-based causal discovery framework that separates time series into trend, seasonal, and residual components for component-specific causal analysis.

entry.title: Causal Preference Elicitation

author.name: Edwin V. Bonilla, He Zhao, Daniel M. Steinberg

entry.summary: Proposes Bayesian causal preference elicitation framework enabling human experts to query local edge relations to refine DAG posteriors using information-gain-based query selection.

entry.title: Contribution-aware Token Compression for Efficient Video Understanding via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yinchao Ma, Qiang Zhou, Zhibin Wang, Xianing Chen, Hanqing Yang, Jun Song, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: CaCoVID uses reinforcement learning to learn contribution-aware token compression for video LLMs, explicitly optimizing token selection for correct answer prediction rather than relying on attention scores.

entry.title: Your AI-Generated Image Detector Can Secretly Achieve SOTA Accuracy, If Calibrated

author.name: Muli Yang, Gabriel James Goenawan, Henan Wang, Huaiyuan Qin, Chenghao Xu, Yanhua Yang, Fen Fang, Ying Sun, Joo-Hwee Lim, Hongyuan Zhu

entry.summary: Shows AI-generated image detectors exhibit systematic bias from distributional shift, proposes Bayesian decision theory-based post-hoc calibration with learnable scalar correction achieving near-SOTA performance.

entry.title: Learning Generative Selection for Best-of-N

author.name: Shubham Toshniwal, Aleksander Ficek, Siddhartha Jain, Wei Du, Vahid Noroozi, Sadegh Mahdavi, Somshubra Majumdar, Igor Gitman

entry.summary: Shows that small (1.7B) reasoning models can acquire strong generative selection capabilities for Best-of-N through targeted RL training on synthesized selection tasks from math and code datasets.

entry.title: SoMA: A Real-to-Sim Neural Simulator for Robotic Soft-body Manipulation

author.name: Mu Huang, Hui Wang, Kerui Ren, Linning Xu, Yunsong Zhou, Mulin Yu, Bo Dai, Jiangmiao Pang

entry.summary: SoMA creates 3D Gaussian Splat simulator coupling deformable dynamics, environmental forces, and robot actions in unified latent neural space for end-to-end real-to-sim soft-body manipulation.

entry.title: Active Causal Experimentalist (ACE): Learning Intervention Strategies via Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Patrick Cooper, Alvaro Velasquez

entry.summary: ACE learns experimental design as sequential policy using Direct Preference Optimization, exploiting that relative comparisons between interventions remain meaningful even as absolute information gains diminish.

entry.title: MemSkill: Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents

author.name: Haozhen Zhang, Quanyu Long, Jianzhu Bao, Tao Feng, Weizhi Zhang, Haodong Yue, Wenya Wang

entry.summary: MemSkill reframes memory operations as learnable and evolvable skills rather than static hand-designed procedures, with controller learning to select relevant skills and executor producing skill-guided memory updates.

entry.title: Harvest: Opportunistic Peer-to-Peer GPU Caching for LLM Inference

author.name: Nikhil Gopal, Kostis Kaffes

entry.summary: Presents Harvest for GPU cache management exploiting peer-to-peer interconnects to dynamically place LLM weights and KV cache in unused GPU memory. Treats peer GPU memory as transient cache tier with correctness guarantees.

entry.title: Direct Preference Optimization with Rating Information: Practical Algorithms and Provable Gains

author.name: Luca Viano, Ruida Zhou, Yifan Sun, Mahdi Namazifar, Volkan Cevher, Shoham Sabach, Mohammad Ghavamzadeh

entry.summary: Extends DPO to incorporate rating information beyond binary preferences, providing practical algorithms with provable gains. Addresses ambiguity in response quality interpretation during alignment.

entry.title: Investigating the Robustness of Subtask Distillation under Spurious Correlation

author.name: Pattarawat Chormai, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Gr\'egoire Montavon

entry.summary: Evaluates subtask distillation methods under spurious correlations, finding that advanced methods like SubDistill maintain robustness while baseline methods degrade significantly as correlation strength increases.

entry.title: BicKD: Bilateral Contrastive Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Jiangnan Zhu, Yukai Xu, Li Xiong, Yixuan Liu, Junxu Liu, Hong kyu Lee, Yujie Gu

entry.summary: Proposes bilateral contrastive knowledge distillation (BicKD) introducing class-wise comparison and structural constraints on probability space missing from vanilla KD.

entry.title: Hyperbolic Graph Neural Networks Under the Microscope: The Role of Geometry-Task Alignment

author.name: Dionisia Naddeo, Jonas Linkerh\"agner, Nicola Toschi, Geri Skenderi, Veronica Lachi

entry.summary: Questions the paradigm that hyperbolic GNNs are always better for tree-like graphs by introducing geometry-task alignment condition. Shows hyperbolic bias only helps when target metric structure matches input graph.

entry.title: Scientific Theory of a Black-Box: A Life Cycle-Scale XAI Framework Based on Constructive Empiricism

author.name: Sebastian M\"uller, Vanessa Toborek, Eike Stadtl\"ander, Tam\'as Horv\'ath, Brendan Balcerak Jackson, Christian Bauckhage

entry.summary: Introduces Scientific Theory of a Black-Box (SToBB) framework grounded in Constructive Empiricism for XAI, requiring empirical adequacy, adaptability, and auditability across model lifecycle.

author.name: Hamza Adnan, Matthew T. Jackson, Alexey Zakharov

entry.title: Finite-Sample Wasserstein Error Bounds and Concentration Inequalities for Nonlinear Stochastic Approximation

author.name: Seo Taek Kong, R. Srikant

entry.title: 3DGS$^2$-TR: Scalable Second-Order Trust-Region Method for 3D Gaussian Splatting

entry.title: Density-Informed Pseudo-Counts for Calibrated Evidential Deep Learning

entry.title: Verification Required: The Impact of Information Credibility on AI Persuasion

author.name: Saaduddin Mahmud, Eugene Bagdasarian, Shlomo Zilberstein

entry.title: Inferential Question Answering

author.name: Jamshid Mozafari, Hamed Zamani, Guido Zuccon, Adam Jatowt

entry.title: Wiki Live Challenge: Challenging Deep Research Agents with Expert-Level Wikipedia Articles

entry.title: Focus-dLLM: Accelerating Long-Context Diffusion LLM Inference via Confidence-Guided Context Focusing

entry.title: Unveiling the Cognitive Compass: Theory-of-Mind-Guided Multimodal Emotion Reasoning

entry.title: DDP-WM: Disentangled Dynamics Prediction for Efficient World Models

author.name: Shicheng Yin, Kaixuan Yin, Weixing Chen, Yang Liu, Guanbin Li, Liang Lin

entry.title: EffGen: Enabling Small Language Models as Capable Autonomous Agents

author.name: Gaurav Srivastava, Aafiya Hussain, Chi Wang, Yingyan Celine Lin, Xuan Wang

entry.title: FlyPrompt: Brain-Inspired Random-Expanded Routing with Temporal-Ensemble Experts for General Continual Learning
